translations.source: Seventy-sixth World Health Assembly – Daily update: 27 May 2023 First global strategy on infection prevention and controlThe World Health Assembly agreed today on the first-ever global strategy on infection prevention and control (IPC), which builds on almost two decades of efforts led by WHO and partners. The strategy provides Member States with strategic directions to substantially reduce the ongoing risk of health care-associated infections (HAIs), including those that exhibit antimicrobial resistance. HAIs are among the most frequent adverse events occurring in the context of health service delivery. The COVID-19 pandemic and recent major disease outbreaks such as Ebola virus disease, the Middle East respiratory syndrome and the Sudan virus disease have clearly exposed the existing gaps in IPC programmes in all countries. The strategy sets a clear vision: by 2030, everyone accessing or providing health care is safe from associated infections. Its three key objectives are: to prevent infection in health care; act to ensure IPC programmes are in place and implemented; and coordinate IPC activities with other areas and sectors. The strategy is focused on any setting where health care is delivered, across the health system; it is based on the principle of clean and safe care as a fundamental component of the right to health, which is equity driven, and which should ensure accountability and sustainability. The global IPC strategy will be complemented by, and used in conjunction with, an associated global action plan and monitoring framework, that will be developed in 2023–2024. Related document EB152/9 - Draft global strategy on infection prevention and control, Executive summary Report by the Director-General WHO's work on infection prevention and control Historic resolution paves the way for strengthening rehabilitation in health systemsToday the World Health Assembly agreed a landmark resolution on strengthening rehabilitation in health systems. Rehabilitation services play a key role in ensuring the enjoyment of human rights including the highest attainable standard of physical and mental health. It also promotes sexual and reproductive health, and recognizes the right to work and the right to education. This landmark resolution aims to address the challenges in rehabilitation such as the need to: increase awareness of rehabilitation when setting health priorities and research agendas, allocating resources, promoting cooperation and enabling technology transfer; ensure countries are better equipped to respond to the sudden increase in rehabilitation needs including assistive technology due to health emergencies; ensure persons in marginalized and vulnerable situations have access to affordable, quality and appropriate rehabilitation services including assistive technology; avoid high out-of-pocket costs for people to access rehabilitation services and assistive technology that can cause financial hardships; and address the current insufficient level of rehabilitation workforce to serve the needs of the population. The resolution lists a range of actions to be taken by the WHO Secretariat such as: publishing a baseline report by the end of 2026 with information on the capacity of Member States to respond to rehabilitation needs; developing targets and indicators for effective coverage of rehabilitation services by 2030; ensuring appropriate resources are allocated at WHO to support Member States in implementing technical guidance and resources; and supporting Member States to integrate rehabilitation and assistive technology in their emergency preparedness and response plan. The WHO Secretariat will report on progress in the implementation of this resolution to the Health Assembly in 2026, 2028 and 2030.
translations.reference: Umhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha - ukubuyekezwa kwansukuzonke: ngo-27 kuNhlaba 2023. Isu lokuqala lomhlaba lokuvikela kokuthelelana nokulawula uMhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba uvumile namhlanje ukuthi isu lomhlaba lokuqala ngqa ekuthelelaneno nokubavikela nokulawula (IPC) Okwakha cishe amashumi nyaka amabili yemizamo eholwa yiWHO nababambisani,. Isu linikeza iMember States ngezindlela zamasu zokugcineka kokwehlisa ubungcuphe obuqhubekayo kwezokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuhlobene nokuthelelana(HAIs) okufaka leyo mibukiso yokuvimba ama-antimicrobial. Ama-HAI akweminye imicimbi eyahlukene ejwayeleke kakhulu eyenzeka kungqikithi yokulethwa kwemisebenzi yezempilo. Ubhubhane lweCOVID-19 nokubheduka kwezifo ezinkulu kamuva nje njengesifo segciwane i-Ebola, isifo sokuphefumula saseMiddle East nesifo segciwane eSudan sekuveze ngokusobala izikhala kuzinhlelo ze-IPC kuwona wonke amazwe. Isu liveza umbono ocacile: ngo-2030 wonke umuntu oyothola noma ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuphephile okusuka nokuhlobene nokutheleleka. Izinjongo ezintathu ezibalulekile: ukuvikela ukuthelelana kwezokunakekelwa kwezempilo; isenzo sokuqinisekisa izinhlelo ze-IPC ezikhona nokwenza nokuxhumana nemisebenzi ye-IPC kwezinye izindawo kanye nemikhakha. Isu ligxile kunoma yikuphi ukuhlela lapho ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kulethwa, kuzona zonke izinhlelo zempilo, ligxile kumgomo wokuhlanzeka nokuphepha njengezinto ezibalulekile kubulungiswa bezempilo okulethwa ngokulingana futhi kuzoqinisekisa ukuzibophezela nokugcineka. Isu lomhlaba le-IPC lizohambisana noma lizosetshenziswa ngokuhlanganisa noma ukuhlobana nesu lokwenza lomhlaba nomhlahlandlela wokubheka,ozodevelophwa ngo-2023-2024. Idokhumenti ehlobene EB152/9 - Isu lomzamo womhlaba ekuvikelweni kokuthelelana nokulawula, okugoqiwe kombiko we-Executive nguMqondisi Jikelele. Umsebenzi weWHO ekuvikeleni nokulawula ukutheleleka,kuyisinqumo esingumlando esivula indlela yokuqinisa ukuhlumelelisa isimilo kuzinhlelo zempilo namhlanje eMhlanganweni weZempilo woMhlaba kuvunyelenwe ngesikhonkwane sesinqumo ekuqiniseni ukuhlunyeleliswa kwezinhlelo zempilo. Imisebenzi yokuhlumelelisa isimilo idlala indima enkulu ukuqinisekisa ukujabulela amalungelo abantu okufaka izinga elitholakalayo eliphezulu lesiqu kanye nezempilo zengqondo. Kuphinde kugqugquzele ezocansi nezempilo yokuzala, kubona ilungelo lokusebenza kanye nelungelo lezemfundo. Lesi sinqumo sesikhonkwane ihlose ukubhekana nezingqinamba yokuhlumelelisa isimilo ngendlela edingeka ngayo: ukunyusa ukugqugquzela kokuhlunyeleliswa kwesimilo uma kuhlelwa okuhamba phambili kwezempilo kanye nama-ajenda okucwaninga, ukufakwa kwezinsizakusebnza, ukugqugquzela ukusebenzisana nokuvumela ukudluliswela kwezobuchwepheshe; ukuqinisekisa amazwe acijiswe kangcono ukuphendula ngokusesha kokunyuka ezidingweni zokuhlunyeleliswa kwesimilo okufaka ukusiza kobuchwepheshe ngenxa yokuphuthuma kwezempilo; ukuqinisekisa abantu abagcindezelekile nabasezinweni zokuhlupheka babenokungena okukhonekayo,okufanele nemisebenzi yokuhlumelelisa isimilo efanele okufaka ukusiza kwezobuchwepheshe; gwema ukubiza okungaphandle kwephakethe kubantu ukuthola imisebenzi yokuhlunyeleliswa kwesimilo kanye nokusizwa kwezobuchwepheshe okungadala ubunzima kwezezemali; futhi ukubhekana nezinga elinganele lamanje lokusebenza kokuhlunyeleliswa kwesimilo ukusiza izidingo zesibalo sabantu. Uhla lwezinqumo lokwahlukana kwezenzo okumele zithathwe nguNobhala weWHO njenge: Ukushicilela isizinda sombiko ekupheleni kuka-2026 ngolwazi ngamandla eMember States ukuphendula ezidingweni zokuhlunyeleliswa kwesimilo; ukudevelopha okuqondiwe nezinkomba ngokukhava okufanele kokuhlunyeleliswa kwesimilo ngo-2030; ukuqinisekisa izinsizakusebenza ezifanele ezizofakwa kuWHO ukweseka iMember States ekwenzeni ukulawula kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nezinsizakusebenza; futhi ukweseka iMember States ukuthi ihlanganise ukuhlunyeleliswa kwesimilo nokusiza kwezobuchwepheshe ekuzilungiseleliseni okuphuthumayo kanye nohlelo lwempendulo. Unobhala weWHO uzobika ngokuqhubeka kokwenza kwalesisinqumo eMnhlanganweni weZempilo ngo-2026, 2028 kanye no-2030.
translations.hypothesis: Umhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha-ukubuyekezwa kwansuku zonke: 27 Nhlaba 2023 Isu lokuqala lomhlaba lonke lokuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka Umhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba uvumile namuhla isu lokuqala lomhlaba lokuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka (IPC), elakhela emizamweni yeminyaka engamashumi amabili eholwa yiWHO kanye nozakwethu. Lesu luhlinzeka Amazwe angamaLungu ngamaqondisa amasu okunciphisa kakhulu ubungozi baqoqo oluqhubekayo kwezifo ezihlobene nokunakekelwa kwezempilo (HAIs), okuhlanganisa neziyakhombisa ukumelana nama-antimicrobial. AmaHAI aphakathi kwezimo ezimbi ezivame kakhulu zenzeka esimweni sokulethwa kwezinsiza zezempilo. Umqedazwe weCOVID-19 kanye neziqhumo zezifo ezinkulu zakamuva njengesifo se-Ebola virus, iMiddle East respiratory syndrome kanye ne-Sudan virus disease seyeveze ngokusobala izikhala ezikhona ezinhlelweni ze-IPC kuwo wonke amazwe. Lesu luhlose ukusungula umbono ocacile: ngo-2030, wonke umuntu othola noma uhlinzeka ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo uphephile ekungeneni izifo ezihlobene. Izinhloso zayo ezintathu ezibalulekile yilezi: ukuvimbela ukutheleleka ekunakekelweni kwezempilo; yenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ze-IPC zikhona futhi zisetshenziswayo; futhi ukuxhumanisa imisebenzi ye-IPC nezinye izindawo nezimikhakha. Lesu liyagxila kunoma yisiphi isimo lapho kunikezwa khona ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, kuzo zonke izinhlelo zezempilo; kusekelwe kumgomo wokunakekelwa okuhlanzekile nokuphephile njengengxenye ebalulekile yelungelo lokuba nempilo, eliqhutshwa ukulingana, futhi okufanele liqinisekise ukuziphendulela nokusimama. Isu le-IPC lomhlaba wonke lizosekelwa, futhi lisetshenziswe kanye, nohlelo lokusebenza lomhlaba wonke oluhlobene kanye nohlelo lokuqapha, oluzokwakhiwa ngo-2023-2024. Amadokhumenti ahlobene EB152/9 - Umzamo wesu lomhlaba wonke lokuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka, Isifinyezo se-Executive Umbiko nguMqondisi Jikelele Umsebenzi weWHO ekuvimbeleni nasekulawuleni ukutheleleka Isinqumo esibalulekile sivula indlela ekuqiniseni ukuhlunyeleliswa ezinhlelweni zezempilo Namuhla Umhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba uvumile isinqumo esibalulekile sokuthuthukisa ukuhlunyeleliswa ezinhlelweni zezempilo. Izinsiza zokuhlunyeleliswa zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukujutshwa kwamalungelo abantu okuhlanganisa izinga eliphezulu lempilo yomzimba nengqondo. Iphinde ikhuthaze impilo yocansi nokuzala, futhi ibonelela ngelungelo lokusebenza nelokufunda. Lesi sinqumo esibalulekile sihlose ukubhekelela izinselele ekuhlunyelelweni njenge: ukwandisa ukuqwashisa ngokuhlunyeleliswa uma kukhonjwa izinto ezibalulekile zezempilo kanye nama-ajenda ocwaningo, ukwabiwa kwezinsiza, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana kanye nokwenza kube lula ukudluliselwa kwezobuchwepheshe; ukuqinisekisa amazwe alungiselelwe kangcono ukuphendula ekwandeni okungazelelwe kwezidingo zokuhlunyeleliswa okuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bokusiza ngenxa yezimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo; ukuqinisekisa abantu abasengcupheni nasezimweni ezingacwusheki ukuthi bathola izinsiza zokuhlunyeleliswa ezithengekayo, ezisezingeni eliphezulu futhi ezifanele ezihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bokusiza; ukugwema izindleko eziphezulu ezingaphezulu kwemali ephuma ephaketheni labantu ukuthola izinsiza zokuhlunyeleliswa kanye nobuchwepheshe bokusiza obungadala ubunzima bezezimali; futhi ukubhekelela izinga elinganele lamanje labasebenzi bokuhlunyeleliswa ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Lesi sinqumo siqaphela izenzo ezahlukene ezizothathwa nguNobhala we-WHO njenge: ukushicilela umbiko wesisekelo ekupheleni kuka-2026 olunolwazi lomkhulu wamazwe angamaLungu ukusabela ezidingweni zokuhlunyeleliswa; ukuthuthukisa izinhloso nezinkomba zokukhava okusebenzayo kwezinsiza zokuhlunyeleliswa ngo-2030; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ezifanele zabelwa kuWHO ukusekela Amazwe angamaLungu ekuqaliseni isiqondiso kanye nezinsiza zezobuchwepheshe; kanye nokusekela Amazwe angamaLungu ukuthi ahlanganise ukuhlunyeleliswa kanye nobuchwepheshe bokusiza ohlelweni lwabo lokulungiselela izimo eziphuthumayo kanye nokusabela. Unobhala weWHO uzobika ngenqubekelaphambili ekuqalisweni kwalesi sinqumo kuMhlangano weZempilo ngo-2026, 2028 kanye no-2030.

translations.source: Related document: EB152/8 - Strengthening rehabilitation in health systems, Report by the Director-General Related link WHO's work on rehabilitation The items above were discussed as part of the document A76/7 Rev.1 - Consolidated report by the Director-General. Resolution on strengthening diagnostics capacity On 26 May Member States endorsed a resolution to strengthen diagnostics capacity in countres and to improve access to diagnostic services. The broad ranging resolution recognizes that diagnostic services are vital for the prevention, surveillance, diagnosis, case management, monitoring and treatment of communicable, noncommunicable, neglected tropical and rare diseases, injuries, and disabilities. Diagnostics allow for the precise identification of diseases, and therefore the timely initiation of the correct treatments for better health outcomes. The resolution considers the full spectrum of “diagnostics”, thus including both “in vitro” laboratory tests e.g. rapid diagnostic tests and polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and “non in vitro” diagnostics e.g. imaging or blood pressure measurement devices. It covers actions for research and development, manufacturing (including local production and technology transfer), regulation, selection and procurement, awareness, advocacy and addressing access barriers in general. The implementation of the resolution will build and expand on previous and current work at three levels of WHO to help countries improve access to diagnostic services. The Secretariat is requested to report on implementation progress in 2025. Related document EB152/6 Strengthening diagnostics capacity
translations.reference: Idokhumenti ehlobene: EB152/8 - ukuqinisa ukuhlunyeleliswa kwesimilo kuzinhlelo zezempilo, umbiko ngu Mqondisi Jikelele Ilinki ehlobene Umsebenzi weWHO ekuhlunyelelisweni kwezimilo Izinto ngasenhla zadingidwa njengengxenye yedokhumenti A76/7 Rev.1 - Umbiko ohlanganisiwe nguMqondisi Jikelele. Isinqumo sokuqinisa amandla okuxilonga Ngomhlaka-26 kuNhlaba iMember States bavume isinqumo sokuqinisa amandla okuxilongaemazweni nokwenzangcono ukungena emisebenzini yokuxilonga. Ububanzi bokwahlukana kwezinqumo kubona ukuthi imisebenzi yokuxilonga ibalulekile ekuvikeleni, ukubheka nokuxilonga, ukuphathwa kwecala, ukubheka nokulapha okuxhunyanwa ngakho, okungaxhunyanwa ngakho izifo ezinganakiwenezifo ezingajwayelekile, ukulimala nokukhubazeka. Ukuxilonga kuvumela ukucaca kokuhlonza izifo,ngakho ke ukuqala ngesikhathi kokwelasha okufanele kwemiphumela yezempilo engcono. Isinqumo sithatha ukwahluka okuphelele kokuxilongwa ngakho kuhlanganisa kokubili vitro ukuhlolwa kwaselebhu, isibonelo ukuphindwa phindwa kokuhlolwa kokuxilongwa kanye nokuvela kwesheni lepholierase (PCR) kanye nokunyona ivitro, isibonelo, ukuhlanganisa nomaumfutho wgazi namadivayisi okukala. Kukhava izenzo zokucwaninga nokuthuthuka ukukhiqiza (okufaka umkhiqizo wendawo nokudluliselwa kobuchwepheshe), ukulawula, ukukhetha nokuthenga, ukuqwashisa nokumela nokubhekana nezivimbo zokuthola ezijwayelekile. Ukwenza kwesinqumo kuzokwakha nokwandisa emsebenzini eyedlule neyamanje kumazinga amathathu eWHO ukusiza amazwe enze kangcono ukuthola ezokuxilongwa. Unobhala ucelwe ukuthi abike ngokuqhubeka kokwenza ngo-2025. Idokhumenti ehlobene EB152/6 Ukuqinisa amandla okuxilonga
translations.hypothesis: Amadokhumenti ahlobene: EB152/8 - Ukuqinisa ukuhlunyeleliswa ezinhlelweni zezempilo, umbiko nguMqondisi Jikelele. Isixhumanisi esihlobene Nomsebenzi weWHO ekuhlunyelelweni. Izinto ezingenhla zaxoxwa ngazo njengengxenye yomathini A76/7 Rev.1 - Umbiko ohlanganisiwe nguMqondisi Jikelele. Isinqumo sokuqinisa amandla okuxilonga Ngomhla zingama-26 kuNhlaba Amazwe Angamalungu agunyaze isinqumo sokuqinisa amandla okuxilonga emazweni nokuphakamisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zokuxilonga. Isinqumo esibanzi sibona ukuthi izinsiza zokuxilonga zibalulekile ekuvimbeleni, ekuqapheni, ekuxilongeni, ekuphathweni kwamacala, ekuqapheni nasekwelashweni kwezifo ezithathelanayo, ezingathathelani, ezinganakiwe emazweni ashashalazayo kanye nezifo ezingajwayelekile, ukulimala kanye nokukhubazeka. Ukuxilongwa kuvumela ukuhlonzwa okunembile kwezifo, ngakho-ke ukuqala ngesikhathi kokwelashwa okufanele ukuze kube nemiphumela emihle yezempilo. Lesi sinqumo sicabanga ngohla olugcwele lwezici zokuxilonga, ngakho-ke kuhlanganisa kokubili ukuhlolwa kwaselabhorethri "in vitro" isb. ukuhlolwa kokuxilonga okusheshayo kanye nomsebenzi we-polymerase chain reaction (PCR) kanye nokuxilongwa "okungekona i-in vitro" isb. izithombe noma amadivaysi okukala umfutho wegazi. Ihlanganisa izenzo zocwaningo nentuthuko, ukukhiqiza (okuhlanganisa ukukhiqiza kwasendaweni nokudluliselwa kobuchwepheshe), ukulawula, ukukhetha nokuthenga, ukuqwashisa, ukumela kanye nokubhekelela izithiyo zokufinyelela ngokuvamile. Ukuqaliswa kwesinqumo kuzakha futhi kwandise umsebenzi oselusele kanye nowamanje kumazinga amathathu eWHO ukusiza amazwe athuthukise ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zokuxilonga. Unobhala uceliwe ukuthi asebenzise umbiko wokuqhubeka ngokuphathelene nokuqaliswa ngowezi-2025. Amadokhumenti ahlobene EB152/6 Ukuqinisa amandla okuxilonga

translations.source: Awards for outstanding contributions to public health presented during the Seventy-sixth World Health Assembly During a moving ceremony at the Seventy-sixth World Health Assembly in Geneva, awards were presented to persons and institutions from around the world for their outstanding contributions to public health. “The 2023 public health prizes and awards celebrate people who have made a significant contribution to global health, and whose work has extended far beyond the call of normal duty,” said Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, WHO Director-General. “At a time when the world faces many challenges, each is an inspiration and a reminder of the progress that can be made to improve health and wellbeing for all.” The call for nominations of candidates for each prize is sent out each year after closure of the World Health Assembly. Nominations can be made by national health administrations of a WHO Member State and by any former recipient of the prizes. At its 152nd session in January 2023, the Executive Board designated the 2023 winners of the prizes, on the basis of proposals made by the dedicated selection panels for each prize. The seven laureates have been selected to celebrate their unique role and contribution for public health in their countries and globally. They come from four WHO Regions – for the Americas, the Eastern-Mediterranean, South-East Asia and the Western Pacific. Five winners are individuals, and three among them are women. In addition, the two institutions that have received a 2023 award are led by women. Winners of the 2023 prizes Sasakawa Health PrizeThe 2023 laureates: The Nick Simons Institute from Nepal, and Professor Vichai Tienthavorn from Thailand The Nick Simons Institute is a nongovernmental organization aiming to improve health care in the rural areas of Nepal. Working closely with the Ministry of Health and Population of Nepal, the Institute has trained 7000 medical professionals (such as midwives and anaesthetic assistants) in rural areas, who now provide most-needed services to local communities in the absence of a sufficient pool of general practitioners and specialists. The Institute has supplied essential equipment and provided additional health personnel to alleviate the lack of medical professionals in 44 hospitals, and supported the design of an action plan for better quality services in more than 100 rural hospitals. The Institute also conducts research and advocacy activities to shape perceptions and influence policies that affect rural health workers in Nepal. Professor Vichai Tienthavorn is President of the Praboromarajchanok Institute at the Ministry of Public Health of Thailand. One of the nation-wide initiatives he has led is an innovative health promotion policy to help address thalassemia, with his work resulting in the adoption of an effective national policy for thalassemia prevention and control. He also designed an effective communications tool and screening method to help citizens to adapt their behaviours in order to prevent and control diabetes and hypertension. As a result of this work, a national policy was adopted with significant positive impact on the country’s disease burden. Professor Tienthavorn also played an essential role in addressing the challenge of uneven distribution of the health workforce, especially in border and rural areas of Thailand. He led the establishment of partnerships with village schools to recruit high-school students, train them and help them settle back locally after having accomplished an accelerated medical curriculum. United Arab Emirates Health Foundation Prize2023 award laureate: Dr Maria Asuncion Silvestre from the PhilippinesIn addition to being a renowned clinician and researcher, Dr Maria Asuncion Silvestre is a passionate advocate for exclusive breastfeeding and the founder of Kalusugan ng Mag-Ina (Health of Mother and Child) – a Philippine non-governmental organization. Dr Silvestre has leveraged her experience as a community practitioner to conduct research and design a protocol to help improve the health of mothers and newborns. The pioneering protocol she created describes a simple set of actions to be undertaken by health workers attending a mother during delivery and her newborn after birth.
translations.reference: Imiklomelo yokunikela okumangazayo lwezempilo lomphakathi eyethulwe NgoMhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha. Ngesikhathi somcimbi wokuthutha woMhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha obuseGeneva, imiklomelo yethulwe kubantu kanye nezikhungo emhlabeni wonke ngokunikela kwabo okumangazayo kwezempilo yomphakathi. "Imiklomelo yezempilo yomphakathi yango-2023 kanye nemiklomelo yokubungaza abantu baenze umehluko omkhulu kwezempilo yomhlaba, nomsebenzi wabo osudlule lokhu obekulindelekile," kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi Jikelele weWHO. Ngesikhathi umhlaba ubhekene nezingqinamba eziningi,ngayinye iyisikhuthazi futhi njengesikhumbuzi sokuqhubeka esingenziwe ukwenzangcono ezempilo nokuphila kuwona wonke umuntu. Isimemezelo sokukhethwa kwezihambeli ngomklomelo ngamunye siyakhishwa unyaka ngamunye ngemva kokuvalwa koMhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba. Ukukhethwa kungenziwa abaphathi bezempilo bezwe beWHO Member State futhi noma yimuphi oke wathola umklomelo. Kuseshini yesi-152 yangoMasingana 2023, i-Executive Board yangesi-2023 abanqobi bemiklomelo, ngokwezimakamiso ezenziwe yiphaneli ekhethiwe ezimisele yomklomelo ngamunye. Abayisikhombisa abahlnishwe ngemiklomelo sebekhethiwe ukubungaza indima yabo ehlukile nokunikela kwezempilo yomphakathi emazweni abo nasemhlabeni wonke. Baqhamuka kuZifunda ezine zeWHO-kuma-America, Eastern-Mediterranean, South East Asia kanye neWestern Pacific. Abanqobile bahamba ngabodwa futhi abathathu babo ngabesifazane. Ukwengeza izikhungo ezimbili sezithole umklomelo wango 2023 obuholwa ngabesifazane. Abanqobi bemiklomelo ya-2023 Sasakawa Health Preize The 2023: iNick Simons Institute yaseNepa, noSolwazi Vichai Tiethavorn waseThailand. Isikhungo iNick Simons inhlangano ezimele ehlose ukwenzangcono ukunakekelwa kwezempilo ezindaweni zasemakhaya eNepal. Ukusebenzisana noNgqongqoshe weZempilo nesibalo sabantu waseNepal, isikhungo sesiqeqeshe izifundiswa zokwelapha ezingu-7000 (okungabahlengikazi ababelethisayo kanye nabaszi bezokuhlinza) ezindaweni zasemakhaya, manje abanikezela ngemisebenzi edingeka kakhulu emiphakathini yendawo ekungabini khona kwephuli eyanele yabasebenzi abajwayelekile kanye nongoti. Isikhungo sesinikele ngempahlakusebenza ebalulekile nokunikela ngabasebenzi bezempilo abengeziwe ukuqeda ukwentuleka kwezifundiswa zokwelapha ezibhedlela ezingu-44, futhi beseka ukwakhiwa kohlelo kwenza ukuze kube nokusebenza okufanele okungcono ezibhedlela zasemakhaya ezingaphezu kuka-100. Isikhungo siphinde senze ucwaningo nemisebenzi yokumela ukwakha imicabango nomthelela kwinqubomgomo enomthelela kubasebenzi bezempilo yasemakhaya eNepal. USolwazi Vichai Tienthavorn unguMongameli wePraborormarajchanok Institute NjengoNgqongqoshe weZempilo yoMphakathi eThailand. Eminye yemizamo esemhlabeni wonke isiholele ekwenzeni kabusha inqubomgomo yokugqugquzela ezempilo, ngalomsebenzi oletha umphumela wokuthatha inqubomgomo yezwe esebenzayo yokuvikela ithalassemia nokuyilawula. Uphinde wakha indlela enhle yethuluzi lokuxhumana nendlela yokuhlola ukusiza izakhamizi zijwayele ukuziphatha kwazo ukuze zivikele nokulawula ushukela nehayi hayi. Njengomphumela walomsebenzi, inqubomgomo yezwe yathathwa ngomthelela omuhle obalulekile emthwalweni wesifo sezwe. Usolwazi Tienthavorn iphinde yadlala indawo ebalulenkile ekubhekaneni nengqinamba yokuhanjiswa okungalingani komsebenzi wezempilo, ikakhulukazi kumngcele nasezindaweni zasemakhaya aseThailand. Wahola okwakuqaliwe kokubambisana nezikole zasemakhaya ukuheha abafundi basezikolweni zamazinga aphezulu, baqeqeshwe nokubasiza bazinze ezindaweni zasekhaya emva kokuqeda ukuqhutshekwa kohlelokusebenza lwezokulapha. Ukuhlonishwa ngemiklomelo kwemiklomelo 2023 eUnited Arab Emirates Health Foundation: uDkt Maria Asuncion Silverstre wasePhilippinesln wengeze ngabelaphayo abahloniphekayo nabacwaningi, uDkt Maria Asuncion Silverstre uyakuthokozela ukumela okwehlukile kokuncelisa ibele kanye nomsunguli weKalusugan ng Mag-Ina (Ezempilo zamama nengane) inhlangano ezimele yasePhilippine. UDkt Silvestre unamandla ngesipiliyonin sakhe njengomsebenzi womphakathi owenza ucwaningo futhi wenza indlela yokwenza ukusiza ukwenza ngcono ezempilo yomama kanye nezingane ezizelwe. Ingqalabutho yendlela yokwenza ayenzile uchaza isethi elula yokwenza okumele ithathwe ngabasebenzi bezempilo ababhekana nomama ngesikhathi sokubeletha nokunakekelwa kwengane yakhe emva kokuzalwa.
translations.hypothesis: Imiklomelo yemigomo ebalulekile kwezempilo yomphakathi ethwele ngesikhathi soMhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha. Ngesikhathi sokuphakanyiswa ngesikhathi soMhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba wamashumi ayisithupha nesithupha eGeneva, imiklomelo yanikezwa kubantu nezikhungo ezivela emhlabeni wonke ngeminikelo yabo ebalulekile kwezempilo yomphakathi. "Imiklomelo yezempilo yomphakathi ka-2023 kanye nemiklomelo igubha abantu abenze umnikelo omkhulu kwezempilo yomhlaba wonke, futhi abasebenza kakhulu ngaphezu kwesikhalo somsebenzi ovamile," kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO. "Ngesikhathi umhlaba ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, ngakunye kuyinto ekhuthazayo futhi iyisikhumbuzo sokuqhubeka okungenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo nokuphila kahle kwabo bonke." Isicelo sokugunyaza abazongenela umklomelo ngamunye sithunyelwa minyaka yonke ngemva kokuvalwa koMhlangano weZempilo woMhlaba. Ukugunyazwa kungenziwa ngabaphathi bezempilo bezwe weWHO Member State kanye nanoma yimuphi umuntu othole imiklomelo. Engqungqutheleni yayo yama-152 kuMasingana 2023, iBhodi Eliphethe labaqa abawinile imiklomelo ka-2023, ngokusekelwe kuziphakamiso ezenziwa ama-panel akhethiwe ngamunye umklomelo. Abawinile abayisikhombisa basele ukugubha indima yabo ehlukile kanye nomnikelo wezempilo emphakathini emazweni abo kanye nasemhlabeni jikelele. Bavela ezifundeni ezine zeWHO - emazweni aseMelika, eMpumalanga yeMedithera, eNingizimu-mpumalanga ye-Asia kanye naseNtshonalanga yePacific. Abawinile abahlanu ngabantu, futhi abathathu kubo abesifazane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo ezimbili ezithole umklomelo ka-2023 ziholwa abesifazane. Abawinile bemiklomelo ka-2023 IMiklomelo yeSasakawa Health Prize 2023: Abawinile abangama-laureate: I-Nick Simons Institute evela e-Nepal, noSolwazi Vichai Tienthavorn ovela eThailand I-Nick Simons Institute iyinhlangano engekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni ehlose ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwezempilo ezindaweni zasemakhaya e-Nepal. Isebenza eduze noNgqongqoshe Wezempilo kanye Nesibalo Sabantu sase-Nepal, i-Institute iqeqeshe ochwepheshe bezokwelapha abangu-7000 (njengabalomama nabasebenza ama-anaesthetic) ezindaweni zasemakhaya, abangafaka izinsiza ezidingeka kakhulu emiphakathini yendawo lapho kungekho amachibi amaningi adokotela abaqalayo kanye nochwepheshe. I-Institute ihlinzeke ngemishini ebalulekile futhi ihlinzeke ngabasebenzi abengeziwe bezempilo ukuze kuncishiswe ukushoda kochwepheshe bezokwelapha ezibhedlela ezingama-44, futhi isekele ukwakhiwa kohlelo lokusebenza lwezinsiza ezisezingeni elingcono kakhulu ezigulini zezibhedlela zasemakhaya ezingaphezu kwe-100. I-Institute iphinde yenze ucwaningo kanye nemisebenzi yokumela ukuze ilolonge imibono futhi ithonyele imigomo ethinta abasebenzi bezempilo basemakhaya e-Nepal. USolwazi Vichai Tienthavorn UnguMongameli wePraboromarajchanok Institute kuMinistry of Public Health of Thailand. Esinye sezinqumo ezihamba phambili akuholile wuhlelo lokuthuthukisa impilo ukuze kuthuthukiswe i-thalassemia, futhi umsebenzi wakhe uholele ekuthathweni kwenqubomgomo kazwelonke ephumelelayo yokuvikela nokulawula i-thalassemia. Uphinde wadizayina ithuluzi lokuxhumana elisebenzayo kanye nendlela yokuhlola ukusiza izakhamuzi ukuthi zivumelanise ukuziphatha zazo ukuze zivimbele futhi zilawule isifo sikashukela kanye nomfutho wegazi ophakeme. Ngenxa yalokhu kwenziwa, kwathathwa inqubomgomo kazwelonke enomthelela omkhulu omuhle esimweni sezwe sezifo. USolwazi Tienthavorn naye wadlala indima ebalulekile ekubhekaneni nezinselele zokuhanjiswa okungalingani kwabasebenzi bezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemngceleni nasezindaweni zasemakhaya eThailand. Wahola ukusungulwa kobambiswano nezikole zasezindaweni ukuze aqashe abafundi basezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu, abaqeqeshe futhi abasize bazimele emuva kwasebesebenza ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zezokwelapha ezisheshayo. I-United Arab Emirates Health Foundation Prize 2023 umklomelo uNksz. Dr Maria Asuncion Silvestre ovela ePhilippines Ngaphezu kokuba ngumelaphi nowcwaningi odumile, uDkt Maria Asuncion Silvestre ukhuthaza kakhulu ukuncelisa ibele ngendlela efanele kanye noMsunguli weKalusugan ng Mag-Ina (Impilo kaMama nengane) inhlangano yasePhilippines engakhokhi umbuso. UDkt Silvestre usebenzise ulwazi lwakhe njengomsebenzi emphakathini ukwenza ucwaningo nokwakha iphrothokholi ukusiza ukuthuthukisa impilo komama nabantwana abasanda kuzalwa. Iphrothokholi yokuqala eyayiyidale ichaza izenzo ezilula okufanele zithathwe abasebenzi bezempilo abebhekelela umama ngesikhathi sokubeletha kanye nengane yakhe esanda kuzalwa ngemva kokubeletha.

translations.source: This protocol, which is applicable in all resource settings, helps to bridge the health equity gap in mother-and-child care. In partnership with the national government of the Philippines as well as 17 countries in the WHO Western Pacific Region, she has played a key role in scaling up the First Embrace campaign for Early Essential Newborn Care – a set of simple WHO-recommended and cost-effective interventions. His Highness Sheikh Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah Prize for Research in Health Care for the Elderly and in Health Promotion 2023 award laureates: The National Center for Chronic and Noncommunicable Disease Control and Prevention from China; and Dr Abla Mehio Sibai from Lebanon The National Center for Chronic and Noncommunicable Disease Control and Prevention, part of the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC), has hosted a department focusing on the health of older people since 2013. It delivers a broad range of programmes and activities that advance health promotion for older people, ranging from better understanding the causes of morbidity and mortality through national surveillance for noncommunicable diseases, surveys, death registries and research, to tailored programmes to promote health literacy and evidence-based policies. Initiatives include a dedicated toolkit for older people, capacity‑building of 2000 primary care staff, a health advocacy week dedicated to older people, and an innovative project to improve the mental and cognitive health of more than half a million older persons in both urban and rural areas. Dr Abla Mehio Sibai is Professor of Epidemiology and Dean of the Faculty of Health Sciences at the American University of Beirut in Lebanon. She has made an outstanding contribution to older people’s health in Lebanon and the region, developing a holistic approach to the promotion of healthy ageing. She led the innovative initiative of enrolling close to 600 older people every year at the University for Seniors at the American University of Beirut, in addition to training public health professionals. She co-led the landmark WHO Global Burden of Disease Study in Lebanon (2000) and conducted the first national survey on noncommunicable diseases and risk factors, informing advocacy, policy-making and programme planning for health promotion. Building on her numerous achievements, Dr Sibai has developed the “National Strategy for Older Persons” in Lebanon (2020–2030). Dr Sibai also created the Arab Ageing Network and the Centre for Studies on Ageing to create links between research and policy at the national, regional and international levels. Dr LEE Jong-wook Memorial Prize for Public Health 2023 award laureate: Dr Jorge Francisco Meneses from Guatemala Having promoted community participation in hospital care for over 20 years, Dr Jorge Francisco Meneses set up community-based committees focusing on the safety and satisfaction of patients, their families and the community. Given the positive impact of his work in improving the quality of patient care, the model of ethical and patient-centred care that he designed was scaled up at the national level. Nowadays, as the national supervisor for hospitals of Guatemala, he has designed a programme to improve the quality of services for hospital patients and their families. Dr Meneses has recently coordinated an innovative pilot project in the Guatemala South Health Area to build the first national integrated network of health services, with a priority focus on underserved communities. His work led to the adoption of a national strategy of integrated health services networks, the first in Central America. Nelson Mandela Award for Health Promotion 2023 award laureate: Dr Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma from Bahrain In addition to being the Chief Executive Officer of the National Health Regulatory Authority of Bahrain, Dr Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma has held various leadership positions in government and academic institutions in her country. Dr Al Jalahma has played a major role in the development of numerous national and region-wide strategies and plans in the field of primary healthcare, child and adolescent health, chronic diseases and antismoking. In her current role, Dr Al Jalahma has led major successful initiatives, such as the national accreditation system for health institutions, the digital transformation of the National Health Regulatory Authority, and several initiatives leading to increased efficiency and excellence in the health sector.
translations.reference: Indlela yokwenza esebenzayo kukhona konke ukuhlela kuzona zonke izinsizakusebenza,isiza ukudlula isikhala sokulingana kwezempilo ekunakekelweni kwamama nengane. Ekubambisaneni nohulumeni wezwe lasePhilippine kanye namazwe angu-17 Ewho Western Pacific Region, usedlale indima ebaluleke kakhulu ekunyuseni umkhankaso wokwamukela kuqala wokusheshe kunakekelwe umntwana ozelwe - isethi yesibonelo iWHO - eliphakamisile nokungenelela okubiza kahle. Ingonyama Sheikh Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah umklomelo wokucwaninga kwezokunakekelwa kwezempilo kwabantu abadala nokugqugquzela ezempilo. 2023 nomklomelo wabahlonishwe ngemiklomelo: Isizinda sezwe sokulawulwa kwezifo ezingamahlalakhona nezifo okungaxhunyanwa ngazo nokuvikelwa okuphuma eChina noDkt Abla Mehio Sabai waseLebanon. Isizinda sezwe sezifo ezingamahlalakhona nokulawula izifo okungaxoxwa ngazo nokuzivikela, ingxenye yesizinda samaChinese yokulawula nokuvikela izifo (China CDC) isisingathe umnyango wokugxila kwezempilo yabantu abadala kusukela ngo-2013. Kuletha izinhlelo eziningi ezahlukene kanye nemisebenzi eyenza ngcono ukugqugquzelwa kwempilo yabantu abadala, okusuka ekuqondeni kangcono izimbangela zemobhidithi, nokushona ngokubhekwa kwezwe kwezifo okungakhulunywa ngazo ukubhaliswa kokufa kanye nocwaningo, ukuhlangaisa izinhlelo zokugqugquzela ukufunda ngezempilo kanye nokuncike kubufakazi. Imizamo ifaka ukuzinikela isikhwama samathuluzi sabantu abadala,amandla okwakha sokunakekela abasenzi bezokuqala abangu-2000, ukumela ezempilo ngesonto kunikelwe kubantu abadala, kanye nephrojekthi yokwenza kabusha ukwenza kangcono kwezempilo yengqondo kwabantu abanguhhafu wesigidi abadala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni nasemakhaya. Udkt Abla Mehio Sibai unguSolwazi wobhubhane neDini yoMnyango weZesayensi yeZempilo eNyuvesi yase America yaseBeirut eLebanon. Usefake isandla okumangazayo kwezempilo yabantu abadala eLebanon nakusifunda, ukudevelopha indlela ephelele ekugqugquzeleni ezempilo zabagugile. Wahola umzamo wokwenza kabusha wokufundisa abalinganiselwa ku-600 abantu abadala unyaka ngamunye eNyuvesi yeSeniors eAmerica University yaseBeirut, ukwengeza ukuqeqeshwa kwezifundiswa kwezempilo zomphakathi. Uhole isikhonkwane seWHO womthwalo womhlaba wesifundo sesifo eLebanon (2000) futhi wenza isaveyi yezwe yokuqala ngezifo okungaxhunyanwa ngazo nezinto eziyingcuphe, ukumelwa kolwazi nokwenza inqubomgomo nokuhlela izinhlelo nokugqugquzela ezempilo. Uma sakhela kwakutholile okuningi, uDkt Sibai udevelophe iNational Strategy for Old Persons, eLebanon (2020-2030). UDkt Sibai uphinde enze i-Arab Ageing Network neSizinda seZemfundo seZalukwazi ukwenza ukuxhumana phakathi kocwaningo nenqubomgomo ezweni, esifundeni kanye nasemazingeni amazwe angaphandle. Umklomelo weSikhumbuzo kaDkt Lee Jong-wook weZempilo zoMphakathi. 2023 umklomelo wabahloniphiweyo: uDkt Jorge Francisco Meneses waseGuatemala. Ukuba nomphakathi ogqugquzeliwe ekunakekelweni kwesibhedlela ngaphezu kweminyaka engu-20, uDkt Jorge Francisco Meneses uhlanganise amakomiti omphakathi agxile ekuphepheni nokwaneliseka kweziguli, imindeni yazo kanye nomphakathi. Uma ubheka umthelela omuhle womsebenzi wakhe wokwenza ngcono ukunakekelwa kweziguli okuhle, imodeli yobuqotho nokunakekelwa okuzinze ezigulini eyakhiwelwe ukunyusa izinga lezwe. Kulesikhathi samanje, njengenduna yezwe yezibhedlela zaseGuatemala,wenza uhlelo lokwenza ngcono ukwenziwa kahle kwemisebenzi kweziguli ezibhedlela kanye nemindeni. UDkt Meneses usanda kuxhumanisa ukuzama ngendlela entsha yephrojekthi eGuatemala South Area ukwakha uhlelokuxhumana lezwe oluhlanganisiwe lokuqala lwemisebenzi yezempilo, ngokuhambisa phambili ukugxila emphakathini ethola okuncane. Umsebenzi wakhe uholele ekuthathweni kwesu lezwe lokuhlanganisa izinhlelozokuxhumana emisebenzini yezempilo, okokuqala maphakathi ne-America. Umklomelo waNelson Mandela wokugqugquzela ezempilo 2023 umklomelo wabahlonishiwe: uDkt Mariam Athbi waseBahrain. Ukwengeza ekubeni nguChief Executive Office yeNational Health Regulatory Authority yaseBahrain, uDkt Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma usebambe izikhundla zokuhola eziningi kuhulumeni kanye nezikhungo zezemfundo ezweni lakhe. UDkt Al Jalahma udlale indima enkulu ekuthuthukiseni okukhulu kwamasu esifundeni sonke kanye nezinhlelo emkhakheni wokunakekela ezempilo zokuqala, ezempilo zamabhobhodlane nezingane,izifo ezingamahlalakhona nokuyeka ukubhema. Esikhundleni sakhe samanje, uDkt Al Jalahma usehole imizamo emikhulu ebalulekile, njengokwenza kahle ohlelweni lwezikhungo zezempilo, uguquko lwedijithali lweNational Helath Authority kanye nemizamo embalwa yokuhola ukunyusa ukwenza kahle nokuhle emkhakheni wezempilo.

Ngokwakhela phezu kwempumelelo yakhe eminingi, uDkt Sibai usungule “Isu Likazwelonke Labantu Abadala” e-Lebanon (2020-2030). Namuhla, njengomqondisi wezibhedlela zase-Guatemala, udizayine uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izinga lezinsiza zeziguli ezibhedlela kanye nemindeni yazo. UDkt Meneses usanda kuhlanganisa iphrojekthi yokuqala yokuqala endaweni yezempilo yaseGuatemala South ukuze kwakhiwe inethiwekhi kazwelonke yokuqala yezinsiza zezempilo, ngokugxila okubalulekile emiphakathini enganakiwe. Umsebenzi wakhe uholele ekuthathweni kwesu likazwelonke leminethiwekhi yezinsiza zezempilo ezihlanganisiwe, okokuqala eCentral America. I-Nelson Mandela Award for Health Promotion 2023 abazuzi beziklomelo: UDkt Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma waseBahrain Ngaphezu kokuba yi-Chief Executive Officer yeNational Health Regulatory Authority yaseBahrain, uDkt Mariam Athbi Al Jalahma ube nezikhundla eziningana zobuholi ezikhungweni zikahulumeni nezamfundo ezweni lakubo. UDkt Al Jalahma udlale indima enkulu ekuthuthukisweni kwamasu kanye nezinhlelo eziningana ezibanzi ngokuphathelene nomkhakha wezempilo yokuqala, impilo yezingane kanye nentsha, izifo ezingalaphekiyo kanye nokunqanda ukubhema. Endimeni yakhe yamanje, uDkt Al Jalahma uholile imizamo eminingi ephumelelayo, njenge-akhisheni kazwelonke yezikhungo zezempilo, inguquko yedijithali yeNational Health Regulatory Authority, kanye nezinyathelo ezimbalwa eziholele ekwenzeni kahle nasekwenzeni kahle emkhakheni wezempilo.
