translations.source: Collaborating locally is key for progress globally towards health-related SDGs A new progress report is being jointly released today by the 13 signatory agencies of the Global Action Plan for Healthy Lives and Well-being for All (SDG3 GAP). The report entitled “What worked? What didn’t? What’s next?” reflects four years of joint work by major multilateral agencies outlining what has and has not worked in strengthening collaboration and support to accelerate country progress towards health-related Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). This year marks the halfway point toward the SDGs, but the world is lagging behind to reach the global goals. Since its launch in 2019, the SDG3 GAP enabled creation of new collaboration structures between the signatory agencies in key areas such as sustainable financing and primary health care among others. At least 67 countries engaged in on one or more of the SDG3 GAP accelerator themes. "We have made important progress, but we still have a long path to travel to improve the way that multilateral organizations work together to support countries. We must listen to what countries tell us and act upon their guidance,” said Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, WHO Director-General and Chair of the SDG3 GAP Principals Group. “I thank the partners for their collaboration and for the honest self-assessments contained in this report. "The report provides six key recommendations to ensure that countries benefit from a more streamlined support and to realize the commitments made in the SDG3 GAP. These include: continue the SDG3 GAP improvement cycle for health by seeking the views of Member States on how we collaborate at country-level and responding to related recommendations; maintain GAP as a platform for collaboration; foster stronger collaboration at the country level on primary health care and explore new thematic topics such as climate resilient health systems; jointly apply new approaches at country level such as the delivery for impact approach; engage more with civil society; and work with Member States to strengthen incentives for collaboration through political leadership, governance direction and funding to support collaboration. Key findings of the report will feed into discussions of the next United Nations General Assembly SDG Summit and the High-level Meeting on Universal Health Coverage in September 2023. The months leading up to these key events provide an opportunity for a joint push by Member States and multilateral agencies to identify ways on how to implement the recommendations and to prepare the ground to fully leverage stronger collaboration and accelerate progress towards the health-related SDGs in the second half of the SDG timeframe. Note to the editor: The SDG3 GAP describes how the 13 signatory agencies will adopt new ways of working, building on existing successful collaborations, and jointly align their support around national plans and strategies that are country-owned and -led. The signatories to the SDG3 GAP are Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance; Global Financing Facility for Women, Children and Adolescents (GFF); Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (Global Fund); International Labour Organization (ILO);
translations.reference: Ukubambisana endaweni kubalulekile ekuqhubekeni emhlabeni okuya kokuhlobene nezempilo zamaSDG Umbiko wokuqhubeka omusha ukhishwe ngokuhlanganyela namhlanje kuma ejensi asayinile angu-13 eGlobal Action Plan for Helath Lives and Well being for All (SDG3 GAP). Umbiko usihloko esthi "What worked? What didn’t? What’s next?" uma kubhekwa iminyaka emine kusetshenzwa ndawonye ngama-ejensi ezindlela eziningi ezinkulu kuvezwa ukuthi yikuphi okusebenzile nokungasebenzanga ekuqinisweni ukubambisana nokwesekwa kwenqubeko yezwe okuuya nokuhlobene nezempilo zeSustainable Development Goals (amaSDG). Lo nyaka umaka iphuzu lahhafu eliya kumaSDG kodwa umhlaba usele ngemuva ukufika kuzinhloso zomhlaba. Kusukela ngokwethulwa kwayo ngo-2019, iSDG3 GAP yenze ukubambisana okusha kwezinhlaka phakathi kokusayina kwama ejensi ezindaweni ezibalulekile njengokugcineka kwezimali nokunakekelwa kwezempilo kokuqala kwabanye abantu. Okungenani amazwe angu-67 akhulumile kanye noma ngaphezulu ngeSDG3 GAP ukuqhuba izingqikithi. Senze inqubeko ebalulekile, kodwa kusanendlela ende okumele siyihambe ukwenza ngcono indlela izinhlangano eziningi ezisebenzisana ngayo ukweseka amazwe. Kumele silalele esikutshelwa ngamazwe futhi silandele imiyalelo,kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi Jikelele weWHO noSihlalo weSDG3 GAP kuzinhloko zeqoqo. "Ngibonga ababambisani ngokubambisana kwazo nokuzihlola ngokwethembeka okuqukethwe kulombiko. "Umbiko unikeza iziphakamiso eziyisithupha ezibalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amazwe ayazuza ekwesekweni okukhishiwe nokubona ukuzibophezela okwenziwe kuSDG3 GAP. Lokhu kufaka: Ukuqhubeka kokwenza ngcono kweSDG3 GAP kwezempilo ngokufuna imibono yeMember State ukuthi sibambisana kanjani ezingeni lezwe nokuphendula okuhlobene neziphakamiso; Ukugcina iGAP njengenkundla yokubambisana; ukulondoloza ukubambisana okuqinile ezingeni lezwe ekunakekelweni kwezempilo kokuqala nokubheka izindlela ezintsha njengesimo sezulu sokubekezela kuzinhlelo zempilo; Ngokuhlanganyela sebenzisa izindlela ezintsha ezingeni lezwe njengokuhambisa indlela yomthelela; ukukhuluma kakhulu nomphakathi; kanye nokusebenza neMember States ukuqinisa imiklomelo yokubambisana ngobuholi bezepolitiki,indlela yokubusa noxhasomali lokweseka ukubambisana. Imiphumela ebalulekile yombiko sizoyifaka ezingxoxweni kuUnited Nations General Assembly SDG Summit elandelayo nomhlangano wezinga eliphezulu kuUniversal Helath Coverage ngoMandulo 2023. Izinyanga eziholela kulezigameko ezibalulekile zinikeza ithuba ukuphusha ndawonye yiMember States kamaejensi ezindlela eziningi ukuhlonza izindlela ukuthi kuzokwenziwa kanjani iziphakamiso ukulungiselella indawo yesibambiso esiphelele ukuqina kokubambisana nokuqhuba inqubeko eya kokuhlobene nezempilo SDG kuhhafu wesibili weSDG wesikhathi esibekiwe. Inothi eliya kumhleli: I-SDG3 GAPichaza ukuthi ukusayina kwama ejensi angu-13 kuzithatha kanjani izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza, ukwakha phezu kokubambisana okukhona okuphumelele, ukubambisana okuhambisana nokweseka kwabo ezinhlelweni zezwe namasu okungawezwe futhi aholwa yilo. Ukusayidwa kuSDG3 GAP kuyiGavi ubudlelwane bomgomo; Indawo yezezimali zomhlaba yabesifazane izingane nenstha (GFF); uxhasomali lomhlaba lokulwa kengculaza,isifo sofuba nomalaleveva(Global Fund); I-International Labour Organisation (ILO);
translations.hypothesis: Ukusebenzisana endaweni kubalulekile ukuze kube nentuthuko emhlabeni wonke emgomweni we-SDG ehlobene nempilo Umbiko omusha wokuqhubeka ukhishwe ngokuhlanganyela namhlanje yizikhungo ezi-13 ezisayinile ze-Global Action Plan for Healthy Lives and Well-being for All (SDG3 GAP). Umbiko obhalwe u-“Yini eyasebenza? Yini engazange isebenze? Yini ezayo?” ukhombisa iminyaka emine yokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela kwezikhungo ezinkulu eziningi eziveza ukuthi yini eyasebenza futhi engazange isebenze ekuqiniseni ukubambisana nokweseka ukusheshisa inqubekelaphambili yezwe emgomweni weSustainable Development Goals (amaSDG) ehlobene nempilo. Lo nyaka ukhombisa indlela maphakathi eziqophelweni ezifanele (amaSDG), kodwa umhlaba ususele ngemuva ekufinyeleleni imigomo yomhlaba wonke. Kusukela yethulwa ngo-2019, iSDG3 GAP yenze kwaba khona ukwakhiwa kwezindlela ezintsha zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezingabhalile ezindaweni ezibalulekile njengokuxhaswa ngezimali okusimeme nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo phakathi kokunye. Okungenani amazwe angu-67 abambe iqhaza endimeni eyodwa noma ngaphezulu yeSDG3 GAP accelerator. "Senze inqubekelaphambili ebalulekile, kodwa sisasehamba indlela eside ukuze sithuthukise indlela izinhlangano eziningi ezisebenzisana ngayo ukusekela amazwe. Kumele sizwe ukuthi amazwe ayitshela ini futhi senze ngokweziqondiso zabo," kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO kanye noSihlalo weQembu LabaPhathi beSDG3 GAP. “Ngibonga ababambisene nathi ngokubambisana nokuqagula okuzithandile okutholakala kulombolwethu. "Lo mbiko uhlinzeka iziphakamiso ezibalulekile eziyisithupha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amazwe ayahlomula ekusekelweni okwenziwe lula kanye nokufeza izibopho ezenziwe ku-SDG3 GAP. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: ukuqhubeka nomjikelezo wokuthuthukiswa kweSDG3 GAP kwezempilo ngokufuna imibono Yamazwe Angamalungu ngendlela esisebenzisana ngayo ezingeni lezwe kanye nokusabela kuziphakamiso ezihlobene; ukugcina iGAP njengenkundla yokubambisana; ukukhuthaza ukubambisana okuqinile ezingeni likazwelonke ekunakekelweni kwezempilo okuyisisekelo kanye nokuhlola izihloko ezintsha ezifana nezinhlelo zezempilo ezimelana nesimo sezulu; ukusebenzisa ngokuhlanganyela izindlela ezintsha ezingeni likazwelonke njengendlela yokuletha umthelela; ukuxhumana kakhulu nomphakathi; kanye nokusebenzisana Namazwe Angamalungu ukuze kuqiniswe izikhuthazo zokubambisana ngobuholi bezepolitiki, isiqondiso sokuphatha kanye nokuxhaswa ngezimali ukuze kusekelwe ukubambisana. Okutholakele okubalulekile kumbiko kuzofakwa ezingxoxweni ze-United Nations General Assembly SDG Summit elandelayo kanye neMhlanganweni Wezinga Eliphezulu Mayelana Nokufinyelela Yonke Indawo Kokubhekana Nempilo ngoMandulo wezi-2023. Izinyanga eziqhumile kulezi zimo ezibalulekile zihlinzeka ngamathuba okuhambisa phambili Amazwe Angamalungu kanye nezikhungo eziningi ukuhlonza izindlela zokusebenzisa iziphakamiso kanye nokulungisa indawo ukuze kuzuze kakhulu ukubambisana okuqinile kanye nokusheshisa inqubekelaphambili emgomweni weSDG ehlobene nempilo engxenyeni yesibili yesikhathi seSDG. Inothi kubhali: I-SDG3 GAP ichaza ukuthi izikhungo eziyisithupha ezingabhalile zizosebenzisa kanjani izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza, zisekelwe ekubambisaneni okuphumelelayo okukhona, futhi zihambisane ngokuhlanganyela nokweseka kwazo kuzinhlelo namasu kazwelonke okungokwamazwe futhi kuholelwe. translations.source: New survey results show health systems starting to recover from pandemic After three years of the COVID-19 pandemic, health systems in countries have started showing the first major signs of health system recovery, according to the WHO interim report on the “Fourth round of the global pulse survey on continuity of essential health services during the COVID-19 pandemic: November 2022–January 2023”. By early 2023, countries reported experiencing reduced disruptions in the delivery of routine health services, but highlighted the need to invest in recovery and stronger resilience for the future. Among the 139 countries that responded to the fourth round of WHO’s pulse survey, countries reported continued disruptions in almost one-quarter of services on average. In 84 countries where trend analysis is possible, the percentage of disrupted services declined on average from 56% in July-September 2020 to 23% in November 2022- January 2023. Persisting disruptions are due to both demand- and supply-side factors, including low levels of health care-seeking in communities as well as limited availability of health workers and other health-care resources such as open clinics or available stocks of medicines and products. “It is welcome news that health systems in the majority of countries are starting to restore essential health services for millions of people who missed them during the pandemic,” said Dr Rudi Eggers, WHO Director for Integrated Health Services. “But we need to ensure that all countries continue to close this gap to recover health services, and apply lessons learnt to build more prepared and resilient health systems for the future”. First notable signs of recovery In this new survey, fewer countries reported intentionally scaling back access across all service delivery platforms and essential public health functions since 2020-2021 reporting, showing an important step to return to pre-pandemic levels of service delivery and broader system functioning. By the end of 2022, most countries reported partial signs of service recovery, including in services for sexual, reproductive, maternal, newborn, child and adolescent health; nutrition; immunization; communicable diseases (including malaria, HIV, TB, and other sexually-transmitted infections); neglected tropical diseases; noncommunicable diseases; management of mental, neurological and substance use disorders; care for older people; and traditional and/or complementary care. The number of countries reporting disruption to their national supply chain system reduced from nearly half (29 of 59 responding countries) to about a quarter (18 of 66 responding countries) within the last year. Despite signs of recovery, service disruptions persist across countries in all regions and income levels, and across most service delivery settings and tracer service areas. Countries are also dealing with increasing service backlogs – most frequently in services for screening, diagnosis and treatment of noncommunicable diseases – which can lead to negative consequences as people are delayed access to timely care. Recovering essential health service delivery is critical because disruptions – including to services for health promotion, disease prevention, diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation and palliation – may have even greater adverse health effects at population and individual level than the pandemic itself, especially among vulnerable populations. Integrating COVID-19 services into essential health services In another important step towards system recovery and transition, most countries have made progress in integrating COVID-19 services into routine health service delivery. About 80-90% of countries have fully integrated COVID-19 vaccination, diagnostic and case management services as well as services for post COVID-19 condition into routine service delivery. Still, most countries (80% of 83 responding countries) reported at least one bottleneck to scaling up access to essential COVID-19 tools (e.g. COVID-19 diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines and personal protective equipment - PPE), with health workforce issues and lack of funding representing the most common barriers. Further support needed for recovery, resilience and preparedness Most countries have started to apply what they have learnt during the COVID-19 pandemic, including through the institutionalization of a number of innovative service disruption mitigation strategies into routine health service delivery. These include deployment of telemedicine approaches, promotion of home-based care or self-care interventions, approaches for strengthening health workers availability, capacities and support mechanisms, innovations in procuring and delivering medicines and supplies, more routine community communications, and partnerships with private sector providers. Three quarters of countries reported additional funding allocation towards longer term system recovery, resilience and preparedness. Countries expressed need for WHO support to address remaining challenges in the COVID-19 context and beyond, most frequently related to health workforce strengthening, building the monitoring capacities of health services, designing primary health care -- oriented models of care, governance, policy and planning and financial planning and funding. Note to editors: In the fourth round of WHO’s global pulse survey, 222 countries, territories and areas were invited to respond to a standardized web-based survey between November 2022 and January 2023. The fourth survey followed up on WHO’s previous 2020 and 2021 pulse surveys: Round 1 (May-September 2020), Round 2 (January-March 2021), and Round 3 (November-December 2021) which showed the extent to which the pandemic was affecting the continuity of essential health services and how countries are taking action.
translations.reference: Imiphumela yocwaningo olusha ikhombisa izinhlelo zempilo ziqala ukuba ngcono esikhathini sobhubhane Ngemva kweminyaka emithathu yobhubhane lweCOVID-19 izinhlelo zempilo emazweni seziqale ukukhombisa izinkomba ezinkulu zokuvuseleleka kwezinhlelo zempilo, ngokweWHO umbiko wesikhashana emzuliswaneni wesine wocwaningo lephalisi yomhlaba ekuqhubekeni kwemisebenzi yezempilo ebalulekile ngesikhathi sobhubhane lweCOVID-19: Lwezi 2022-Masingana 2023. Ngokuqala kuka-2023 amazwe abike ukwenzeka kokwehla kokuphazamiseka ekulethweni kwendlela yemisebenzi yezempilo,kodwa kwavezwa isidingo sokutshala kokungalungiswa nokubekezela kakhulu kwikusasa. Kulamazwe angu-139 aphendule kumzuliswane wesine wokuzwakala kocwaningo lweWHO, amazwe abike ukuqhubeka kokuphazamiseka emisebenzini yekota esilinganisweni. Emazweni angu-84 lapho ukuhlaziya okudumile kungenzeka,iphesenti lemisebenzi ephazamisekile yehlile ngesilinganiso esisuka ku-56% ngoNtulikazi kuya kuMandulo 2020 ngo-23 % ngoLwezi 2022-Masingana 2023. Ukuqhubeka kokuphazamiseka kungenxa yakho kokubili ukufuneka nokusaplaya izinkinga eziseceleni, okufaka amazinga aphansi okunakekelwa kwezempilo emphakathini okudingayo kanye nomkhawulo wokubakhona kwabasebenzi bezempilo nezinsizakusebenza ezinye zokunakekelwa kwezempilo njengokuvulwa kwemitholampilo noma ukubakhona kwesitoko semithi nemikhiqizo. "Izindaba ezamukelwayo ukuthi izinhlelozempilo emzaweni amaningi ziqala ukuvuselela imisebenzi yezempilo ebalulekile ezigidini zabantu abawugejile ngesikhathi sobhubhane," kusho uDkt Rudi Eggers, Umqondisi weWHO weMisebenzi yeZempilo yoKuhlanganisiwe. "Kodwa sidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amazwe ayaqhubeka nokuvala izikhala ukuvuselela imisebenzi yezempilo,nokusebenzisa izifundo abazifundile ukwakha izinhlelo zempilo ezizilungiselele nokubekezela kwekusasa". Izimpawu zokuqala eziqaphelekayo ekuvuseleleni Kulolu cwaningo olusha,amazwe ambalwa abike ngokungenhloso isikalo sasemuva sokuthola kuzinkundla zonke umsebenzi wokuletha nokusebenza kwezempilo yomphakathi okubalulekile kusukela 2020-2021 ukubikwa kukhombisa ukubaluleka kwegxathu kubuyelwe emazingeni angaphambi kobhubhane ukulethwa kokusebenza nokusebenza okukhulu kwezinhlelo. Ekupheleni kuka-2022, amazwe amaningi abike izimpawu ezingacacile zokuvuselelwa kokusebenza okufaka ukusebenza kwezocansi, ukuzala, abakhullwe, abazelwe, izingane nezempilo yentsha, ukudla okunempilo ukugomma,izifo ezithelelanayo (okufaka umalaleveva, iHIV, iTB nezinye izifo ezithelelana ngokocansi) izifo ezidumile ezinganakiwe,izifo okungaxhunyanwa ngazo,ukuphathwa kwengqondo, okwengqondo nesifo sokusebenzisa izidakamiza, ukunakekelwa kwabantu abadala nokunakekelwa okulekelelayo nokwesiko. Inombolo yamazwe abika ukuphazamiseka ohlelweni lwawo lesaplayi sheni ezweni okungafika kuhhafu (29 ka-59 wamazwe aphendulayo) okunganekota (18 wa-66 wamazwe) aphedulayo kulonyaka odlule. Ngaphandle kwezinkomba zokuvuselela,ukuphazamiseka komsebenzi kuyaqhubeka emazweni onke namazinga emali engenayo kuzona zonke izinhlelo soomsebenzi wokulatha nokulandelela umsebenzi ezindaweni. Amazwe aphinde abhekane nokunyuka komsebenzi okumele wenziwe - ikakhulukazi emisebenzini yokubheka, ukuxilonga nokwelapha izifo okungaxhunyanwa ngazo - okungaholela kumiphumela engemihle uma abantu bebambezeleka ukuthola ukunakekelwa ngesikhathi. Ukuvuselelwa kwemisebenzi yezempilo ebalulekile kubucayi ngenxa yokuphazamiseka - okufaka imisebenzi yokugqugquzela ezempilo, ukuvinjwa kwezifo, ukwelapha, ukuvuselelwa kwesimilo nephaliyeshini - kungaba nokukhulu umthelela ohlukene wezempil nezinga lomuntu ukunobhubhane qobo ikakhulukazi kubantu babuthaka. Ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi yeCOVID-19 emisebenzini yezempilo ebalulekile elinye igxathu elibalulekile eliya ekuvuselelweni kohlelo noguquko,amazwe amaningi asebe nenqubekela phambili ekuhlanganiseni imisebenzi yeCOVID-19 endleleni yokuletha imisebenzi yezempilo. Cishe u-80%-90% wamazwe ahlanganyele ngokuphelele ekugonyweni kweCOVID-19 ukuxilonga nemisebenzi yokuphathwa kwecala kanye nemisebenzi yesimo sangemuva kweCOVID-19 endleleni yomsebenzi wokuletha. Kuyafana amazwe amaningi (u-80% wamazwe awu-83 aphendulile) abike okungenani okuncane ekukhuphukeni kokuthola amathuluzi abalulekile eCovid-19 (isibonelo ukuxilongwa kweCOVID-19, ukwelaphangxube, imigomo namathuluzi okuzivikela siqu - PPE), ngezinkinga zokusebenza kwezempilo nokwentuleka koxhasomali okumele izivimbo ezijwayeleke kakhulu. Ukuqhubeka kokusekwa kuyadingeka ukuvuselela,ukubekezela nokuzilungiselela Amazwe amaningi aseqalile asebenzisa asebekufundile ngesikhathi sobhubhane lweCOVID-19 okufaka ngezikhungo zenamba yokusbenza kokusha ukuphazamisa amasu endleleni yokulethwa kwezempilo. Lokhu kufaka ukubekwa kwezindlela zokwelapha ngefoni,ukugqugquzela ukunakekelwa usekhaya nokungenelela kokuzinakekela, izindlela zokuqinisa ukubakhona kwabasebenzi bezempilo, amandla nezindlela zokweseka, ukwenza kabusha ekuthengeni nokuletha imithi namasaplayi ezinye izindlela zokuxhumana nomphakathi ukubambisana nabanikezeli bomkhakha ozimele nowomphakathi. Amakota amathathu ezwe abaike ukufakwa koxhasomali olwengeziwe oluya ekuvuselelweni kohlelo lwesikhathi eside, ukubekezela nokuzilungiselela. Amazwe agcizelele isidingo sokwesekwa kweWHO ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezisele ngokwengqikithi yeCOVID-19 nangale,ikakhulukazi okujwayele ukuhlobana nokuqinisa ukusebenza kwezempilo, ukwakha amandla okubheka imisebenzi yezempilo, ukwakha ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kokuqala okuncike kuzindlela zokunakekela, ukubusa, inqubomgomo nokuhlela nokuhlela ezezimali noxhasomali. Inothi kubahleli: Emzuliswaneni wesine wocwaningo lwephasile yomhlaba weWHO, amazwe angu-222, izindawo bamenywa ukuba baphendule kucwaningo oluncike kuwebhu eqinisikesiwe phakathi kukaLwezi 2022 noMasingana 2023. Ucwaningo lwesine lulandele kucwaningo lwephasile edlule yango-2020 no2021 lweWHO: uMzuliswano 1 (Nhlaba-Mandulo 2020) uMzuliswano 2 (Masingana-Ndasa 2021) noMzuliswano 3 (Lwezi-Zibandlela 2021) okwakhombisa ukukhulu bokuthi ubhubhane lalukhahlameza ukuqhubeka kwemisebenzi yezempilo ebalulekile nokuthi amazwe enza kanjani.
translations.hypothesis: Imiphumela yemibiko emisha ikhombisa ukuthi izinhlelo zezempilo ziqala ukuthola okuthile ngemuva kobhubhane. Ngemva yeminyaka emithathu yobhubhane lweCOVID-19, izinhlelo zezempilo emazweni seziqalile ukukhombisa izimpawu zokuqala ezinkulu zokululama kwezinhlelo zezempilo, ngokusho kombiko wesikhashana we-WHO mayelana "Umzuliswano wesine wocwaningo lwe-global pulse lokuthatha izinqumo ekuqhubekeni kwezinsiza zezempilo ezibalulekile ngesikhathi sobhubhane lweCOVID-19: Novemba 2022-Januwari 2023". Ngasekuqaleni kuka-2023, amazwe abike ukubhekana nokuhlukumezeka okuncishisiwe ekulethweni kwezinsiza zezempilo ezivamile, kodwa agcizelele isidingo sokutshala ekululameni nokuqina okukhulu esikhathini esizayo. Phakathi kwamazwe ayi-139 aphendule ocwaningweni lwe-WHO lwesine, amazwe abike ukuqhubeka kokuhlukumezeka cishe kwinkuthukazi yezinsiza. Emazweni ayi-84 lapho ukuhlaziywa kwendlela kungenzeka khona, iphesenti lezinsiza eziphazamisekile lehle ngokwesilinganiso lisuka ku-56% ngoNtulikazi-Mandulo wezi-2020 kuya ku-23% ngoLwezi wezi-2022 - uJanuwari wezi-2023. Ukuphazamiseka okuqhubekayo kubangelwa yizici zombili zezidingo kanye nezokuhlinzeka, okuhlanganisa amazinga aphansi okufunwa kokunakekelwa kwezempilo emiphakathini kanye nokutholakala okulinganiselwe kwabasebenzi bezempilo kanye nezinye izinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo njengamakhliniki avulelekile noma isitokwe esitholakalayo semithi nemikhiqizo. "Izindaba ezimnandi ukuthi izinhlelo zezempilo emazweni amaningi ziqala ukubuyisela izinsiza zezempilo ezibalulekile ezigidini zabantu abazihlangile ngesikhathi sobhubhane," kusho uDkt Rudi Eggers, uMqondisi weWHO we-Integrated Health Services. "Kodwa sidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amazwe ayaqhubeka ukuvala leli gabi ukuze alulame izinsiza zezempilo, futhi asebenzise izifundo ezifundwe ukuze akhe izinhlelo zezempilo ezilungile nezimelayo esikhathini esizayo". Izimpawu zokuqala ezivelele zokululama Kulo cwaningo olusha, ambalwa amazwe abike ukubuyisela emuva okuhlelekile kuzo zonke izinkundla zokuletha izinsiza kanye nemisebenzi yezempilo yomphakathi ebalulekile kusukela ekubikweni kuka-2020-2021, okukhombisa isinyathelo esibalulekile sokubuyela emazingeni okulethwa kwezinsiza ngaphambi kobhubhane kanye nokusebenza okubanzi kwezinhlelo. Ekupheleni kuka-2022, amazwe amaningi abike izimpawu ezithile zokululama kwezinsiza, okuhlanganisa nezinsiza zezempilo eziyintimate, ekuzaleni, komama, abasanda kuzalwa, izingane kanye nentsha; ukudla okunomsoco; ukugonywa; izifo ezithathelanayo (okuhlanganisa umalaleveva, iGciwane lesaNdulela Ngculazi, isifo sofuba, kanye nezinye izifo ezithathelanayo ngokocansi); izifo ezinganakiwe zasezindaweni ezishisayo; izifo ezingathathelaniyo; ukuphathwa kwengqondo, izifo eziphathelene nezinzwa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa; ukunakekelwa kwabantu asebekhulile; kanye nokunakekelwa kwendabuko kanye/noma okulekelelayo. Inani lemazwe abika ukuphazamiseka ohlelweni lwawo lokuhlinzeka lokuhlinzeka lincishiswe lisuka cishe kuhhafu (amazwe angama-29 kwama-59 aphendulile) ukuya cishe engxenyeni yesine (amazwe ayi-18 kwama-66 aphendulile) phakathi nonyaka odlule. Naphezu kwezimpawu zokululama, ukuphazamiseka kwezinsiza kuyaqhubeka emazweni kuyo yonke indawo kanye nasezingeni leholo eliphakeme, kanye nasezilungiselelweni eziningi zokulethwa kwezinsiza kanye nezindawo zokulandelela izinsiza. Amazwe nawo abhekene nokwanda kwezinkinga zezinsiza - ngokuvamile ezinsizeni zokuhlunga, ukuxilongwa kanye nokwelashwa kwezifo ezingathathelaniyo - okungase kubangele imiphumela engemihle njengoba abantu bethiwa bafinyelele ekunakekelweni okufanele. Ukuthola izinsiza zezempilo ezibalulekile kubalulekile ngoba ukuphazamiseka - okuhlanganisa nezinsiza zokukhuthaza impilo, ukuvimbela izifo, ukuxilongwa, ukwelashwa, ukubuyisela emuva kanye nokwelapha - kungase kube nemithelela emibi kakhulu empilweni kubantu kanye nasezingeni lomuntu ngamunye kunobhubhane uqobo, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasengozini. Ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zeCOVID-19 ezinsizeni zezempilo ezibalulekile. Kwesinye isinyathelo esibalulekile sokululama kanye nokushintsha, amazwe amaningi enze inqubekelaphambili ekuhlanganiseni izinsiza zeCOVID-19 ekulethweni kwezinsiza zezempilo ezivamile. Cishe amazwe angama-80-90 ayehlanganisa ngokugcwele ukugonywa kweCOVID-19, ukuxilongwa kanye nezinsiza zokulawula izimo kanye nezinsiza zesimo seCOVID-19 emva kokulethwa kwezinsiza ezivamile. Noma kunjalo, amazwe amaningi (ama-80% wamazwe angama-83 aphendulile) abike okungenani okhokho oyedwa wokwandisa ukufinyelela kumathuluzi e-COVID-19 abalulekile (isib. ukuxilongwa kweCOVID-19, imithi yokwelapha, imithi yokugoma kanye nezinto zokuzivikela - PPE), nezinkinga zabasebenzi bezempilo kanye nokuntuleka koxhaso okumelela izithiyo ezivame kakhulu. Kudingeka ukusekelwa okwengeziwe kokululama, ukuqina nokulungela Okuningi amazwe aqale ukusebenzisa lokho abakufundile ngesikhathi sobhubhane lweCOVID-19, okuhlanganisa nokusungulwa kwamasu amaningana okunciphisa ukuphazamiseka kwezinsiza ezivamile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusatshalaliswa kwezindlela zokwelapha kude, ukukhuthaza ukunakekelwa kwasekhaya noma ukungenelela kokuzikhulula, izindlela zokuqinisa ukutholakala kwabasebenzi bezempilo, amakhono kanye nezindlela zokusekela, izinto ezintsha ekuthengeni nasekulethweni kwemithi nezinsiza, ukuxhumana okuningi nomphakathi, kanye nokubambisana nabahlinzeki bezinkampani ezizimele. Amakota amathathu kwezine amazwe abike ukuhlukaniswa kwemali eyengeziwe ekhokhwayo ekululameni kwesimiso eside, ukuqina nokulungela. Amazwe aveze isidingo sokwesekwa kwe-WHO ukubhekana nezinselelo ezisele esimweni seCOVID-19 nangemva kwawo, ngokuvamile kuhlobene nokuqiniswa kwabasebenzi bezempilo, ukwakha amakhono okubheka izinsiza zezempilo, ukuklama ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyinhloko -- okuyizimodeli ezibhekiswe ekunakekelweni, ukubusa, inqubomgomo kanye nokuhlela kanye nokuhlela izimali kanye nokuxhaswa ngezimali. Inothi kubahleli: Emzuliswaneni wesine we-WHO yomhlaba wonke, amazwe angama-222, izifunda nezindawo zayimenyezelwa ukuthi zizimisele ukusabela ocwaningweni oluvame lwe-web phakathi kukaLwezi wezi-2022 noMasingana wezi-2023. Inhlolovo yesine ilandele ucwaningo lwango-2020 no-2021 lwe-WHO: Umzuliswano wokuqala (Nhlaba-Mandulo wezi-2020), Umzuliswano 2 (Januwari-Mbasa wezi-2021), kanye noMzuliswano 3 (Novemba-Disemba wezi-2021) okhombise ukuthi ubhubhane buthinta kangakanani ukuqhubeka kwezinsiza zezempilo ezibalulekile kanye nokuthi amazwe athatha kanjani izinyathelo.

translations.source: While pulse surveys have limitations such as reporting bias and representativeness, the strength of this effort is that it is comprehensive and delivers information rapidly. The term “country” should be understood to include all countries, territories and areas. Trend analyses was completed based on responses from 84 countries, territories, or areas that responded to at least one survey section in all four pulse survey rounds.
translations.reference: Ngesikhathi ucwaningo lwephasile lunemikhawulo njengokubika ukuchema nokumela,amandla alomzamo ukuthi mukhulu futhi uletha ulwazi ngokuphindekile. Itemu "izwe" kumele liqondwe ukuthi lifaka wonke amazwe, imingcele nezindawo. Abahlaziya okudumile kwaqedwa kuncike ezimpendulweni eziphuma emazweni angu-84, abahlukumezi noma izindawo ezaphendula okungenani kusahluko socwaningo olulodwa kuyona yonke imizuliswano emine yocwaningo.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba ucwaningo lwe-pulse linemikhawulo efana nokubika okubhekisayo kanye nokumela, amandla walomzamo ukuthi anganele futhi adlulisela ulwazi ngokushesha. Igama elithi “izwe” kufanele liqondwe ukuthi lifaka wonke amazwe, izifunda nezindawo. Ukuhlaziywa kwendlela kwapheliswa ngokusekelwe kuzimpendulo eziqhamuka emazweni ayi-84, izifunda, noma izindawo ezaphendula okungenani esigabeni esisodwa socwaningo kuzo zonke izikhathi ezine zocwaningo lwe-pulse.

translations.source: Statement of celebration for HRP’s 50th anniversary: Sweden and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland To capture the spirit of Policy and Coordination Committee (PCC) members celebrating HRP’s 50th anniversary and its numerous achievements, Sweden and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland read the following note of appreciation and congratulations at the 36th meeting of the HRP PCC. Our generation has seen more progress in science and technology than all preceding generations together and witnessed several intellectual, technological, medical and social transformation spearheaded by the contraceptive revolution and followed by advances in reproductive health, health innovations as well as rights and gender equality. However, considerable challenges in the field of SRHR continue, and, arguably, some advances are in question again today. We applaud HRP-staff, partners and supporters on the numerous achievements to date and recognise the enormous strides accomplished during half a century in producing the evidence that supports full and equal access to sexual and reproductive health and rights. We would like to outline three major categories of achievements: Firstly, the high-quality research by HRP has had tangible impact on public health policy, standards, and practice worldwide addressing the evolving needs of diverse populations. Secondly, HRP, notably through the HRP Alliance, has strengthened research institutions locally and globally, and, enabled numerous researchers to acquire the research skills that ensure that high-quality SRHR research can continue, and indeed increase, into the future. Thirdly, in a world beset by crisis, conflict and increasing resistance to gender equality, HRP has facilitated the upholding of the basic rights of women and girls and vulnerable populations. HRP remains the main instrument within the United Nations system for research in human reproduction and continues to be an exceptional leader in global sexual and reproductive health. HRP and its partners have brought us closer to the promise of the 1994 International Conference on Population and Development and its call to put the rights of individuals, especially women and girls, at the heart of sustainable development. We want to express our appreciation and gratitude to the HRP secretariat, its partners, co-sponsors and the global network of collaborating centres and experts helping to ensure its efforts contribute to making a difference to the women, men, children, adolescents and various communities HRP is committed to serve. On behalf of PCC members, allow us to reaffirm our partnership with you to support the achievements of HRP, upon which the success of the 2030 Agenda depends.
translations.reference: Isitatimende sokubungaza ukuphela kweminyaka engu-50 yeHRP: iSweden ne-United Kingdom of Great Britain neNorthen Ireland Ukubamba isimo seNqubomgomo neKomidi lokuXhumana (PCC) Amalungu abungaza ukuphela kuka-50 HRP nokuzuza okuningi, iSweden neUnited Kingdom of Great Britain neNorthern Ireland ukufunda ukuqapheleka okulandelayo kokwamukela nokuhalalisa emhlanganweni wesi-36 weHRP PCC. Isizukulwane sethu sesibone inqubekela phambili enkulu kusayensi nezobuchwepheshe ukuthi konke okuqhubekayo kwesizukulwane ndawonye, nokubona okwemfundo okumbalwa,ezobuchwepheshe, ezokwelapha noguquko lwenhlalakahle luqhutshwa ukuguquka kokuvikela kulandelwa ukwenzangcono kwezempilo yokuzala, ukwenza kabusha kwezempilo kanye namalungelo nokulingana ngokobulili. Kepha ukucabanga izingqinamba emkhakheni weSRHR uqhubeke futhi kuphikiswane,okunye ukuqhubeka kusembuzweni futhi namhlanje. Sincoma abasebenzi beHRP ababambisani nabeseki kwabakutholile okuningi kuze kube yinamhlanje nokubona izinto ezinkulu ezenzekile ngesikhathi esinguhhafu wekhulunyaka ekukhiqizeni ubufakazi obeseka ukungena okuphelele nokulinganayo kwezempilo namalungelo ezocansi nokuzala. Singathanda ukuveza imikhakha emikhulu emithathu yokuzuziwe Okokuqala ucwaningo olusezingeni eliphezulu lweHRP lube nomthelela obonakalayo kunqubomgomo yezempilo yomphakathi,amazinga, nokwenza emhlabeni wonke okubhekene nezidingo zokuguquka kusibalo sabantu esahlukene. Okwesibili HRP iqapheleke ngeHRP Alliance, isiqinise izikhungo zocwaningpo endaweni nasemhlabeni,kwavumela abacwaningi abaningi ukuthi bathole amakhono okucwabinga ukuqinisekisa ubunhalo obuphezulu bocwaningo lweSRHR ukuthi liqhubeke futhi lunyuke esikhathini esizayo. Okwesithathu,umhlaba uhlelwa yizinkinga, ukuxabana nokunyusa ukuqaba ekulinganeni kobulili, iHRP isize ukubamba isisekelo samalungelo abasefazane nezingane nabantu ababuthaka. I-HRP ihlala iyithuluzi elibalulekile kuhlelo lweUnited Nations yocwaningo lokhukhiqiza kubantu nokuqhubeka nokuba umholi ovelele kwezempilo yezocansi nokuzala emhlabeni. HRP nababambisani bayo sebesisondeze kusithembiso sango-1994 KuNkomfa Yamazwe angaphandle Esibalweni Sabantu neNtuthuko, futhi isimemezelo sibeka amalungelo abantu ikakhulukazi abesifazane namantombazane phakathi nokugcineka kwentuthuko. Sifisa ukuzwakalisa ukubonga nokujabula kwethu kunobhala weHRP, ababambisani, kanye nabaxhasi kanye nohlelokuxhumana lomhlaba ezizindeni zokubambisana nongoti abasiza ukwenza isiqiniseko ukuthi imizamo inikela ekwenzeni umehluko kubantu besifazane, amadoda, izingane, intsha, nemiphakathini eyahlukene iHRP izimisele ngokusiza. Ngokubambela amalunga ePCC sivumeleni siqinisekise ukubambisana kwethu nani ukweseka okuzuziwe kweHRP ekuphumeleleni okuncike ku-ajenda 2030.
translations.hypothesis: Isitatimende sokugubha iminyaka engama-50 yeHRP: ISweden kanye ne-United Kingdom of Great Britain kanye neNorthern Ireland Ukuthatha umoya wenqubomgomo kanye neKomidi Lokuxhumanisa (PCC) amalungu asebenza ukugubha iminyaka engama-50 yeHRP kanye nezimpumelelo zayo eziningi, i-Sweden kanye ne-United Kingdom of Great Britain kanye neNorthern Ireland bafundile inothi lokubonga nokuhalalisela emhlanganweni wama-36 weHRP PCC. Isizukulwane sethu sibone inqubekelaphambili enkulu esayensini kanye nobuchwepheshe kunazo zonke izizukulwane ezedlule ngendlela ehlanganisiwe futhi sabona izinguquko eziningana zengqondo, ubuchwepheshe, ezokwelapha kanye nezenhlalo eziholwa inguquko yokuvimbela inzalo futhi alandelwe inqubekelaphambili kwezempilo zokuzala, izinto ezintsha zezempilo kanye namalungelo nokulingana ngokobulili. Kodwa-ke, kuzokwenzeka izinselele ezinkulu emkhakheni we-SRHR, futhi, kungenzeka, ithuthukile, ezinye izinto zibekwe emibuzweni namuhla. Sihalalisela izisebenzi zeHRP, ababambisene nathi kanye nabasekeli ngokuphumelela okuningana kuze kube yimanje futhi siqaphele izinyathelo ezinkulu ezenziwe phakathi nekhulu leminyaka ekukhiqizeni ubufakazi obusekela ukufinyelela ngokugcwele nokulingana kwezempilo eziphathelene nocansi nokuzala kanye namalungelo. Sifuna ukuchaza izigaba ezinkulu ezintathu zezimpumelelo: Okokuqala, ucwaningo lwekhwalithi ephezulu olwenziwe yiHRP luluthe umthelela okhonjwayo kunqubomgomo yezempilo yomphakathi, izindinganiso kanye nokwenza umsebenzi emhlabeni wonke ukubhekelela izidingo ezithuthukayo zabantu abahlukahlukene. Okwesibili, iHRP, ikakhulukazi ngeHRP Alliance, iye yaqinisa izikhungo zocwaningo endaweni nasemazweni omhlaba, futhi, yenze abacwaningi abaningi bakwazi ukuthola amakhono ocwaningo aqinisekise ukuthi ucwaningo lweSRHR lwekhwalithi ephezulu lungaqhubeka, futhi ngempela lukhule, esikhathini esizayo. Okwesithathu, emhlabeni obambene neqhwa, izingxabano kanye nokwanda kokumelana nokulingana ngokobulili, iHRP isize ekugcineni amalungelo ayisisekelo kwabesifazane kanye namantombazane kanye nenani labantu abasengozini. I-HRP isasebenza njengethuluzi eliyinhloko ohlelweni lwe-United Nations locwaningo lokuzala kwabantu futhi iyaqhubeka nokuba ngumholi oyingqayizivele kwezempilo yocansi nokuzala emhlabeni jikelele. I-HRP kanye nozakwethu basisondele esithembisweni seNgqungquthela Yamazwe Omhlaba Yonyaka Wezi-1994 Mayelana Nobantu Nokuthuthukiswa kanye nesimemo sayo sokubeka amalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane kanye namantombazane, enhliziyweni yokuthuthukiswa okusimeme. Sifuna ukwazisa ukubonga kwethu kanye nokubonga unyanga-nthe iHRP, ababambisene naye, abaxhasi ngokuhlanganyela kanye nohlelo lomhlaba wonke lwezikhungo ezisebenzisanayo nochwepheshe abasiza ekuqinisekiseni imizamo yethu ukufaka umehluko kwabesifazane, abesilisa, izingane, intsha kanye nemiphakathi eyahlukene iHRP izibophezele ukuyisebenzela. Egameni lamalungu e-PCC, vumela ukuthi siqinisekise ukubambisana kwethu nawe ukuze sisekele impumelelo yeHRP, lapho impumelelo ye-Ajenda ka-2030 incike kuyo.

translations.source: WHO launches new initiative to improve pandemic preparedness To help countries better prepare for future pandemics, WHO launched a new initiative today that provides guidance on integrated planning for responding to any respiratory pathogen such as influenza or coronaviruses. The new Preparedness and Resilience for Emerging Threats Initiative, or PRET, incorporates the latest tools and approaches for shared learning and collective action established during the COVID-19 pandemic and other recent public health emergencies. Through the initiative, WHO will use a mode of transmission approach to guide countries in pandemic planning, given that many capacities and capabilities are common among groups of pathogens. PRET answers the call for technical guidance and support for promoting and strengthening integrated preparedness and response, as outlined in World Health Assembly resolutions. The COVID-19 pandemic and other health emergencies have shown that countries need to be operationally ready to respond to infectious disease threats, with tailored preparedness plans in hand and better coordination and collaboration with other sectors such as agriculture. “Preparedness, prevention, and response activities must not be the province of the health sector alone,” said Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, WHO Director-General. “Just as health emergencies have impacts across many sectors, so must our preparedness and response efforts span sectors, disciplines and pathogens. It is critical, too, that community engagement and equity are the centre of our efforts, especially for those populations that are marginalized and most at risk.” PRET is an evolution in WHO’s approach to pandemic preparedness through the application of a mode of transmission lens, rather than a focus on specific diseases. WHO will continue to develop and disseminate guidance on specific diseases as needed. The launch of the initiative is taking place on the last day of meetings with over 120 individuals representing Member States, partners, and the WHO secretariat, to define the path forward for PRET, including the development of a global implementation roadmap for respiratory pathogen pandemic preparedness. The PRET Initiative’s first module focuses on respiratory pathogens, including influenza, coronaviruses, and respiratory syncytial virus. Given the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic and the possible threat of avian influenza, this module will enable countries to critically review, test, and update their respiratory pandemic planning efforts to ensure they have the functional capacities and capabilities in place. A process is underway to identify the next group of pathogens, such as arboviruses, to be addressed under this initiative. This will follow priorities identified through the ten proposals to strengthen the global architecture for health emergency preparedness, response, and resilience (HEPR). The PRET Initiative ushers in a new era for pandemic preparedness and represents an evolution of WHO’s core activities to support all Member States in strengthening health emergency preparedness, prevention, and response capacities and capabilities. The initiative can also serve to operationalize the objectives and provisions of the Pandemic Accord, which is currently being negotiated by WHO Member States. Following inputs and discussions among meeting participants, WHO invites stakeholders to this global call to action to advance respiratory pathogen pandemic preparedness. Call to Action WHO, Member States, and partners are working together to identify and implement priority actions to strengthen national, regional, and global preparedness for pandemics and emerging infectious disease threats. We recognize the role of communities and all sectors, and the need for harmonized and sustained momentum to end the cycle of panic and neglect that is all too common in pandemic preparedness and response. We recall lessons from previous epidemics and pandemics, especially those caused by respiratory pathogens. These pathogens have and will continue to pose a significant global threat with the potential to cause tremendous morbidity and mortality, overwhelm health systems, de-stabilize the global economy, and exacerbate inequities, which exist in the access to both the tools to prevent pandemics and health care for all people. This is a Call to Action to accelerate preparedness for pandemics and emerging threats globally.
translations.reference: I-WHO yethula umzamo omusha wokwenza ngcono ukuzilungiselela kobhubhane Ukusiza amazwe ukuthi azilungisele okungcono kwekusasa lobhubhane,WHO yethule umzamo namahlanje ozonikeza imiyalelo yokuhlela ngokuhlanganisa ngokuphendula kunoma iyiphi iphathojini yokuphefumula njengomkhuhlane noma ikhorona. I-Preparedness and Resilience for Emerging Threats Initiative, noma iPRET, ihlanganisa amathuluzi akamuva nezindlela zokufunda okwabelwana ngazo kanye nesenzo esiyiqoqo esisungulwe phakathi nobhadane lweCOVID-19 nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zakamuva zezempilo zomphakathi. Ngomzamo iWHO izosebenzisa indlela yokudlulisela ukuyala amazwe ekuhleleni ubhubhane,ngoba kukhona amandla amaningi namandla amaningi afanayo kumaqoqo ephathojini. I-PRET iphendula isimemezelo somuyalelo wezobuchwepheshe nokwesekwa kokugqugquzelwa nokuqiniswa kokuhlanganisa ukuzilungiselela nokuphendula,njengova kuveziwe kuzinqumo zeWorld Health Assembly. Ububhane lweCOVID-19 nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zikhombisile ukuthi amazwe adinga ukuthi alungele ukubhekana nezinsongo zezifo ezithathelwanayo, ngezinhlelo zokuzilungiselela ezilungiselelwe ngesandla kanye nokuxhumana okungcono nokusebenzisana neminye imikhakha efana nezolimo. "Ukuzilungiselela, ukuvikela nemisebenzi yokuphendula akumele kube yisifundazwe somkhakha wezempilo kuphela," kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi Jikelele weWHO. "Njengeziphuthumayo zempilo zinomthelela kumikhakha eminingi, ngakho nokuzilungiselela kwethu nemizamo yokuphendula mayilingane nemikhakah, izinhlobo namagciwane. Kubucayi futhi ukuthi ukukhuluma komphakathi nokulingana kuphakathi kwemizamo yethu, ikakhulukazi kulabo bantu abagcindezelekile futhi abasengcupheni enkulu." I-PRET iwuguquko endleleni yeWHO ekuzilungiseleni kobhubhane ngokusebenzisa indlela yelensi yokudlulisela, ukunokugxila ezifweni ezithile. I-WHO izoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa nokusabalalisa imiyalelo ezifweni ezithile njengoba kudingeka. Ukwethulwa komzamo kuzokwenzeka ngosuku lokugcina lwemihlangano abangaphezu kuka-120 abamele Member State, ababambisani, noNobhala weWHO, ukuchaza indlela eya phambili yePRET okufaka ukuthuthuka kwebalazwe lokwenza lomhlaba kokuzilungiselela lobhubhane lwegciwane lokuphefumula. Imizamo yePRET isifundo sokuqala sigxile kumagciwane pokuphefumula, okufaka umkhuhlane, igciwane lekhorona namagciwane ezokuphefumula. Ngokunikezwa ubhubhane oluqhubekayo nokwesabisa okungenzeka emkhuhlaneni, lemojuli izokwenza amazwe abheke ngokucophelela, ukuhlola, ukubuyekeza imizamo yokuhlela ubhubhane lwezokuphefumula ukuqinisekisa banamandla okusebenzayo, namandla akhona. Uhlelo lusendleleni lokuhlonza iqoqo elilandelayo lamagciwane, njengama-arbovirus, ukuthi kubhekwane nawo ngaphansi kwalomzamo. Lokhu kuzolandela okuhamba phambili okuhlonziwe ngeziphakamiso eziyishumi zokuqinisa ukwakhiwa komhlaba kokuzilungiselela kokuphuthuma kwezempilo, ukuphendula nokubekezela (HEPR). Umzamo wePRET ukuyisa esikhathini esisha sokuzilungiselela kobhubhane nokumela uguquko lwemisebenzi ngqo yeWHO ukweseka wonke amaMember State ekuqiniseni ezempilo zokuzilungiselela okuphuthumayo, ukuvikela namandla okuphendula nokukwazi. Umzamo ungaphinde usize ukusebenzisa izinjongo nokuhlinzekwa kwePandemic Accord okwamanje okusaxoxwa ngayo yiWHO Member State. Kulandela lokho okufakiwe nezingxoxo emihlanganweni yababambe iqhaza, iWHO imema ababambisani kulesimemezelo somhlaba sokwenza ukuwandisa ukuzilungiselela kobhubhane legciwane lokuphefumula. Kufuneka ukwenza AmaMember State eWHO, nababambisani basebenza ndawonye ukuhlonza nokuhambisa phambili ukwenza izenzo zokuqinisa izwe, isifunda, nokuzilungiselela komhlaba kwezobhubhane nokuvela kwezifo ezithelelanayo ezisabisayo. Siyayibona indima yomphakathi nayo yonke imikhakha sidinga ukulinganisa nokugcina umfutho ekupheleni kwesakile yokusaba nokunganaki lokho kujwayelekile ekuzilungiseleni kobhubhane nokuphendula. Sikhumbula izifundo zobhubhane olwedlule ne-ephidemikhi, ikakhulukazi lezo ezidalwa amagciwane okuphefumula. Lawo magciwane azoqhubeka nokuletha ukusabisa komhlaba okukhulu ngamandla okudala izinkinga ezinkulu nokufa, izinhlelo zempilo ezingaphezu kwamandla, ukwehlisa ezomnotho zomhlaba, ukwengeza ukungalingani, okukhona ekungeneni kumathuluzi omabili okuvikela ubhubhane nokunakekelwa ezempilo kubona bonke abantu. Lesi yisimemezelo sokwenza ukuqhubeza ukuzilungiselela kobhubhane nokuvela kokwesaba emhlabeni.
translations.hypothesis: I-WHO yethula umzamo omusha wokuthuthukisa ukulungela ubhubhane Ukuze isize amazwe ukuthi alungiselele kangcono izifo eziwubhubhane ezizayo, iWHO yethule umzamo omusha namuhla ohlinzeka ngesiqondiso sokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe kokuphendula kunoma yimuphi ama-pathogen aphithizelayo njengomkhuhlane noma igciwane le-coronavirus. Isinyathelo esisha sokulungela kanye nokubekezela ezingozini ezivelayo, noma i-PRET, ihlanganisa amathuluzi nezindlela zakamuva zokufunda okuhlanganyelwe kanye nezenzo ezihlangene ezamiswe ngesikhathi sobhubhane lweCOVID-19 nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo yomphakathi. Ngomzamo, iWHO izosebenzisa indlela yokudlulisela ukuthuthukisa amazwe ekuhleleni ubhubhane, uma kubhekwa ukuthi amandla amaningi nokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi kuyinto ejwayelekile kumaqoqo ama-pathogen. I-PRET iphendula isimemo sokubhekwa kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nokwesekwa kokuthuthukisa nokuqinisa ukuzilungiselela nokuphendula okuhlanganisiwe, njengoba kuchazwe kuzinqumo zeWorld Health Assembly. Ubhubhane lweCOVID-19 nezinye izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zibonise ukuthi amazwe kudingeka alulungele ukusebenza ukuphendula ekusabiseni kwezifo ezithathelanayo, anezinhlelo zokuzilungiselela ezilungiselelwe esandleni kanye nokuxhumana okungcono nokubambisana neminye imikhakha efana nezolimo. “Ukulungela, ukuvimbela, kanye nemisebenzi yokusabela akumele kube umkhakha wezempilo kuphela,” kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO. “Njengoba izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo zinomthelela emikhakheni eminingi, kanjalo kufanele imizamo yethu yokulungiselela nokusabela ihlanganise imikhakha, izifundo kanye nama-pathogen. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi ukusebenzelana nomphakathi kanye nokulingana kube yisizinda semizamo yethu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abantu abasengcupheni kakhulu nasezingcupheni ezinkulu.” I-PRET iyinguquko endleleni yeWHO yokulungiselela ubhubhane ngokusebenzisa ilensi yokudlulisela ukuthelelana, kunokugxila ezifweni ezithile. I-WHO izoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa nokusabalalisa isiqondiso ngezifo ezithile njengoba kudingeka. Ukwethulwa kwesinyathelo kwenzeka ngosuku lokugcina lomhlangano nabantu abangaphezu kwe-120 abamele Amazwe Angamalungu, abalingani, kanye nehhovisi likaNobhala weWHO, ukuze kuchazwe indlela eya phambili ye-PRET, okuhlanganisa nokuthuthukiswa kwemapa yokuqalisa yomhlaba wonke yokulungiselela ubhubhane lwe-pathogen yezifiso zomgudu wokuphefumula. Isifundo sokuqala se-PRET sigxile kuma-pathogen aphithizelayo, okuhlanganisa umkhuhlane, ama-coronavirus, kanye ne-respiratory syncytial virus. Uma kubhekwa ubhubhane lweCOVID-19 oluqhubekayo kanye nosongo lwamakhukhu omkhuhlane, lesi siqophamlando sizovumela amazwe ukuthi abuyekeze, ahlole, futhi abuyekeze imizamo yakhe yokuhlela ubhubhane lokuphefumula ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi anezimiso ezisebenzayo nezimiso ezikhona. Kukhona inqubo eyaqhubeka yokuhlonza iqembu elilandelayo lama-pathogen, njenge-arboviruses, okufanele kubhekelelwe ngaphansi kwalesi senzo. Lokhu kuzolandela izinto ezibalulekile ezihlonziwe ngama-proposal ayishumi okuqinisa isakhiwo somhlaba wonke sokulungiselela izimo eziphuthumayo zezempilo, ukusabela, kanye nokubekezela (HEPR). Isinyathelo se-PRET singasebenza ukuze kufezwe izinhloso kanye nezinhlinzeko zeSivumelwano Sobhubhane, okwamanje sithathelwana ngawona amazwe angamaLungu eWHO. Ngemuva kokufakwa kanye nezingxoxo phakathi kwababambiqhaza emhlanganweni, iWHO imema ababambiqhaza kule mikhankaso yomhlaba wonke ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukulungela ubhubhane lwe-pathogen yezifiso zomgudu wokuphefumula. Ukufuna ukuthatha isinyathelo I-WHO, Amazwe Angamalungu, kanye nabalingani basebenzisana ukuhlonza nokusebenzisa izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuqinisa ukulungela kuzwelonke, esifundeni, kanye nasemhlabeni wonke kwezifo eziwubhubhane kanye nezinsongo zezifo ezithathelanayo ezivelayo. Siyakwazisa indima yemiphakathi kanye nazo zonke izimikhakha, kanye nesidingo se-momentum ehlanganisiwe nokuqhubekayo ukuze kuqedwe umjikelezo wokwethusayo nokunganakwa okuvamile ekulungiseleleni nokusabela kubhubhane. Siyakhumbula izifundo ezivela ezifweni eziwubhubhane kanye neziphuthumayo ezedlule, ikakhulukathile lezo ezibangelwa ama-pathogen aphithizelayo. Lawa ma-pathogen abe futhi aqhubekele phambili ekuqhamukeni njengosongo olubalulekile emhlabeni wonke okunokubangela ukugula kanye nokushona okumangalisayo, ukuxhaphaza izinhlelo zezempilo, ukungazithembi umnotho womhlaba wonke, kanye nokwenza kube nzima ukungalingani, okukhona ekufinyeleleni kokubili amathuluzi okuvimbela izifo eziwubhubhane kanye nokunakekelwa kwezempilo kubo bonke abantu. Lokhu kuwukufuna ukuthatha isinyathelo ukuze kusheshiswe ukulungela izifo eziwubhubhane kanye nezinsongo ezivelayo emhlabeni jikelele.

translations.source: Effective preparedness relies on robust planning and coordinated action. A collective commitment on the following actions will see progress achieved by December 2025 as will be described in the (Preparedness and Resilience for Emerging Threats (PRET) monitoring framework: Update preparedness plans that affirm priority actions and that have considered learnings from past events. Recognizing the risk posed by respiratory pathogens, planning for a respiratory pathogen pandemic based on the themes identified in the PRET Module #1: Planning for Respiratory Pathogen Pandemics is a priority Increase connectivity among stakeholders in pandemic preparedness planning through systematic coordination and cooperation. This includes building equitable systems; conducting joint exercises; and sharing information on good practices, challenges, and opportunities. Dedicate sustained investments, financing and monitoring of pandemic preparedness with a particular focus on addressing the gaps identified during past pandemics and epidemics. The COVID-19 pandemic response has demonstrated what can be achieved with political commitment, community engagement and funding. At the heart of this work is to ensure equity to be ready for the next pandemic together. Whole-of-society action is needed to make the progress outlined in this Call to Action. Implementation should therefore strengthen the resilience of communities; maintain, sustain, and build on routine systems; and leverage broader capacities for emergency preparedness and response. This Call to Action was released at the Preparedness and Resilience for Emerging Threats (PRET): Global Meeting for Future Respiratory Pathogen Pandemics held on 24-26 April 2023 in Geneva, Switzerland.
translations.reference: Ukusebenza kokuzilungiselela kuncike kubukhulu bokuhlela nokwenza kokuxhumana. Ukuzimisela kweqoqo kuzenze ezilandelayo kuzobonisa ukuqhubeka okutholakele ngoZibandlela 2025 futhi kuzochazwa (Ukuzilungiselela nokubekezela kokusabisayo okuvelayo (PRET) ukubheka umhlahlandlela: Ukulungiselelwa kokubuyekeziwe ukuhlela okuqinisekisa izenzo zokuhamba phambili nokucabanga izifundo zezigemegeme ezedlule. Ukubona ingcuphe efakwe amagciwane ezokuphefumula, ukuhlela kobhubhane lamagciwane ezokuphefumula ancike kuzingqikithi ezihlonzwe kusifundo sePRET #1: Ukuhlelela ubhubhane lwamagciwane ezokuphefumula kuhamba phambili Ukunyusa ukuxhumana kubabambisani ekuzilungiseleni kobhubhane ukuhlela ngezinhlelo zokuxhumana nokusebenzisana. Lokhu kufaka ukwakha izinhlelo ezilinganayo ukwenza imisebenzi ngokuhlanganyela; Nokwabelana ngolwazi ekwenzeni okuhle, izingqinamba kanye namathuba. Ukunikela ngotshalomali olugcinekile, izimali nokubheka kokulungela ubhubhane ngokugxila ekubhekeni izikhala ezihlonze ngesikhathi sobhubhane olwedlule. Ubhubhane lweCOVID-19 luphendule ukukhombisa ukuthi yikuphi okungazuzwa ngokuzibophezela kwezepolitiki, ukukhuluma komphakathi kanye noxhasomali. Phakathi nalomsebenzi ukuqinisekisa ukulingana ukulungela obhubhane olulandelayo ndawonye. Ukwenza komphakathi wonke kuyadingeka ukwenza inqubekela phambili evezwe kule simemezelo sokwenza. Ukwenza kumele kuqinise imiphakathi ebekezelayo; egcinayo nokugcineka nokwakha izindlela zezinhlelo; nokubambisa kwamandla amakhulu kokuzilungiselela okuphuthumayo nokuphendula. Lesi simemezelo sokwenza sakhishwa eKuzilungiseleni nokubekezela kokuvela kokusabisayo (PRET): Umhlangano womhlaba wekusasa lobhubhane lwamagciwane ezokuphefumula obanjwe ngo-24-26 Mbasa 2023 eGeneva, eSwitzerland.
translations.hypothesis: Ukulungela ngempumelelo kuncike ekuhleleni okuseqobheni kanye nasezenzweni ezihlangene. Ukuzibophezela ngokuhlanganyela kuzisebenza ezilandelayo kuzobonisa inqubekelaphambili ezuze ngoDisemba 2025 njengoba kuzochazwa ohlakeni lokuqapha lwe-Preparedness and Resilience for Emerging Threats (PRET): Ukubuyekeza izinhlelo zokulungiselela ezivuma izenzo ezibalulekile futhi ezicabange ukuphila okutholakele ezenzakalweni zaphambilini. Ngokubona ingozi ekhishwe amagciwane okuphefumula, ukuhlela ubhubhane lwamagciwane okuphefumula ngokusekelwe kumathimu ahlonziwe ku-PRET Module #1: Ukuhlela Izifo Zomgudu Wokuphefumula kuyinto esemqoka Ukwandisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwababambiqhaza ekuhleleni ukulungiselela ubhubhane ngokuhlangana okuhlelekile kanye nokubambisana. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo ezilinganayo; ukwenza imisebenzi ehlanganyelwe; kanye nokwabelana ngolwazi mayelana nokwenza okuhle, izinselele, kanye namathuba. Ukutshala imali okuqhubekayo, ukuxhaswa ngezimali kanye nokuqapha ukulungiselela ubhubhane ngokugxila ngokukhethekile ekubhekaneni nezikhala ezihlonziwe ngesikhathi sobhubhane kanye nobhubhane olwedlule. Ukusabela kubhubhane lweCOVID-19 kuye kwabonisa lokho okungafinyelelwa kufezeke ngokuzibophezela kwezepolitiki, ukusebenzelana nomphakathi kanye nokuxhaswa ngezimali. Inhliziyo yalo msebenzi ukwenza kube lula ukulingana ukuze silungiselelwe ubhubhane olulandelayo ndawonye. Kudingeka isenzo somphakathi wonke ukuze kwenziwe inqubekelaphambili echazwe kule Call to Action. Ngakho-ke, ukusebenzisa kufanele kuqinise iqiniso lemiphakathi; ukugcina, ukusimamisa, kanye nokwakha phezu kwezinhlelo ezivamile; kanye nokusebenzisa amandla abanzi okuzilungiselela kanye nokusabela ezimweni eziphuthumayo. Lesi Sicelo Senqubo sikhishwe ePreparedness and Resilience for Emerging Threats (PRET): Umhlangano Womhlaba Wonke Wezifo Zomgudu Wokuphefumula Ezizayo obanjwe zingama-24-26 kuMbasa wezi-2023 eGeneva, eSwitzerland.

translations.source: WHO urges increased implementation of recommended tools to combat malaria Marking World Malaria Day, the World Health Organization (WHO) is issuing a call for increased implementation of new and existing interventions to save lives from malaria. Nearly 1.5 million children at high risk of illness and death from malaria in Ghana, Kenya and Malawi have now received their first dose of the first malaria vaccine, RTS,S/AS01 (RTS,S), thanks to an ongoing pilot programme coordinated by WHO. The malaria vaccine pilots, launched in 2019, are increasing equity in access to malaria prevention for the most vulnerable and are saving lives. If implemented broadly, WHO estimates that malaria vaccines could save the lives of tens of thousands of children each year. “We have the tools to drive down malaria, a package of interventions that includes vector control, preventive medicines, testing, and treatment,” said Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Director-General of WHO. “These are joined by a safe and effective malaria vaccine, which could save the lives of tens of thousands children every year. With sustained investment and scaled-up efforts to reach those most at risk, malaria elimination in many countries is in reach. "World Malaria Day 2023 is being marked under the theme “Time to deliver zero malaria: invest, innovate, implement”. Within this theme, WHO is urging more effective implementation of available tools and strategies to prevent, diagnose and treat malaria, particularly among marginalized populations. According to the latest World malaria report, published in December 2022, there were an estimated 247 million new cases of malaria in 2021. The WHO African Region continues to shoulder the heaviest burden of the disease – accounting for an estimated 95% of all malaria cases (234 million) and 96% of all deaths (593 000) in 2021. Nearly 80% of malaria deaths in the African Region were among children under the age of five. New strategies and tools Countries have made some progress in expanding access to malaria services for most-at-risk populations. Despite some progress, many people at high risk of malaria still lack access to services that can prevent, detect and treat the disease. Challenges in expanding access to malaria services have been compounded, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa, by the COVID-19 pandemic, converging humanitarian crises, restricted funding, weak surveillance systems, and declines in the effectiveness of core malaria-fighting tools. To address these threats and support countries in building more resilient malaria programmes, WHO recently published new strategies and frameworks, including: a new strategy to contain antimalarial drug resistance in Africa; a new initiative to stop the spread of Anopheles stephensi in urban environments; a new framework, developed jointly by WHO and UN-Habitat, to guide city leaders in urban malaria control. a new toolkit to help countries assess their malaria surveillance systems and identify areas for investment WHO has also increased the transparency, flexibility and access to its malaria recommendations. The consolidated WHO Guidelines for malaria are now available through two digital platforms: MAGICapp and the “Malaria Toolkit” app. WHO encourages countries to tailor the recommendations to local disease settings for maximum impact.
translations.reference: I-WHO inxenxa ukunyuswa kokwenza ngamathuluzi aphakanyisiwe ukulwa nomalaleveva Ukumaka uSuku lukaMalaleveva eMhlabeni, Inhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba (WHO) izokhipha isimememzelo sokunyusa ukwenza kokungenelela okukhona nokusha ukusindisa izimpilo kumalaleveva. Okungafika kuzigidi ezingu-1.5 izingane ezisengcupheni enkulu yokugula nokufa okusuka kumalaleveva eGhana, eKenya naseMalawi manje sebethole umgomo wokuqala kamalaleveva, RTS, S/AS01 (RTS,S), siyabonga kuhlelo lokuhlola oluqhubekayo oluxhunyaniswa yiWHO. Ukuhlolwa komgomo wamalaleveva, owethulwe ngo-2019,kwenyusa ukulingana kokuthola ukuvikelwa kumalaleveva kulabo ababuthaka kakhulu futhi kusindisa izimpilo. Ukwenziwe kakhulu, iWHO ilinganisela ukuthi umgomo kamalaleveva ungasingisa izimpilo eziyizinkulungwane eziyishumi zezingane ngonyaka. "Sinamathuluzi ukwehlisa umalaleveva,iphekheji yokungenenela ebandakanya ukulawula ivektha,imithi yokuvikela, ukuhlola nokwelapha," kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi Jikelele weWHO. "Lokhu kulandelwa ngumgomo ophephile nosebenzayo kamalaleveva, ongasindisa izimpilo eziyizinkulungwane eziyishumi zezingane unyaka ngamunye. Ngotshalomali olugcinekile nokunyuka kwemizamo ukufika kulabo abasengcupheni kakhulu, ukuqedwa kwamalaleveva emazweni amaningi sekuyafika. "Usuku lukaMalaleveva eMhlabeni 2023 lumakwe ngaphansi kwengqikithi, "Isikhathi sokuwqeda umalaleveva, tshala, yenza kabusha yenza". Kule ngqikithi, iWHO inxenxa okunye ukwenza okusebenzayo kwamathuluzi akhona namasu okuvikela, ukuxilonga nokwelapha umalaleveva, ikakhulukazi kulesosibalo esingcindezelekile. Ngokombiko wokugcina wamalaleveva emhlabeni,oshicilelwe ngoZibandlela 2022, bekunesilinganiso sika-247 wezigidi zamacala amasha kamalaleveva ngo-2021. I-WHO African Region iyaqhubeka ukuthwala umthwalo onzima wesifo- okuballelwa esilinganiswenisa ku-95% wamacala kamalaleveva (u-234 wezigidi) no-96% wokufa (593 000) ngo-2021. Kungafika ku-80% ukufa okudalwa umalaleveva eSifundeni se-Afrika obukukubantwana abangaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu. Amasu amasha namathuluzi Amazweasenze inqubekela phambili ekwandiseni ukungena kumisebenzi yamalaleveva kusibalo sabantu esisengcupheni kakhulu. Ngaphandle kokuqhubeka abantu abaningi abasengcupheni yamalaleveva basantula ukungena emisebenzini engavimba, noma itthole bese yelapha isifo. Izingqinamba ekwandeni kokungena kumisebenzi kamalaleveva sezihlanganisisiwe,ikakhulukazi esu-Saharan Afrika, ngobhubhane lweCOVID-19, ukujika izinkinga zobuntu, uxhasomali olunezivimbo, izinhlelo zokubheka ezintekenteke, ukwehla ekwenzeni kwamathuluzi okulwa ngqo nomalaleveva. Ukubhekana nalokhu okusabisayo nokweseka amazwe ekwakheni izinhlelo zokubekezela zamalaleveva, iWHO isanda kushicilela amasu amasha nomhlahlandlela: isu elisha lelinesidakamizwa esingenamalaleveva ukuvika eAfrika; umzamo omusha wokumisa ukusabalala kweAnophelesi stephensi ezindaweni zasemadolobheni; umhlahlandlela omusha, uthuthukiswe ndawonye yiWHO neUN-Habitat, ukuyalela babaholi bedolobha ekulawulweni kwemalalaeveva edolobheni. ithuluzi elisha ukusiza amazwe ahlola umalaleveva wabio wezinhlelo zokubheka nokuhlonza izindawo zotshalomali I-WHO iphinde yanyusa ukwethembeka, ukubalula nokuthola iziphakamiso zemalaleveva. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemiyalelo yeWHO kwamalaleveva sekukhona manje ngezinkundla ezimbili zedijithali: iMAGICapp kanye ne-"MalariaToolkit" isisetshenziswa. I-WHO igqugquzela amazwe ukuthi ahlanganise kuziphakamiso ekuhlelweni kwezifo zendawo kumthelela omkhulu.
translations.hypothesis: I-WHO ikhuthaza ukwenyuswa kokusebenza kwemithombo etuswa ukulwa nomalaleveva Ukugubha Usuku Lomhlaba LweMalaleveva, iNhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba (WHO) ikhipha isicelo sokwenyuswa kokusebenza kokungenelela okusha nakho kukhona ukuze kuvinjelwe izimpilo emalalevevini. Cishe izingane eziyizigidi eziyi-1.5 ezisengozini enkulu yokugula nokufa umalaleveva eGhana, eKenya naseMalawi manje sezithole umthamo wazo wokuqala womuthi wokugomela umalaleveva wokuqala, iRTS,S/AS01 (RTS,S), ngenxa yohlelo lokuhlola oluqhubekayo oluhlelwe yiWHO. Abaqondisi bokugomela umalaleveva, abaqalwe ngo-2019, bakhulisa ukulingana ekufinyeleleni ekuvimbeleni umalaleveva kwabasengozini kakhulu futhi basindisa izimpilo. Uma kusetshenziswa kabanzi, iWHO ilinganisela ukuthi imithi yokugomela umalaleveva ingasindisa izinkulungwane zezinkulungwane zezingane unyaka ngamunye. “Sinezindlela zokwehlisa umalaleveva, iphakheji yokungenelela ehlanganisa ukulawulwa kwe-vector, imithi yokuvimbela, ukuhlola, nokwelashwa,” kusho uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, uMqondisi-Jikelele weWHO. “Lokhu kuhlanganyelwe nawo umuthi wokugomela umalaleveva ophephile futhi osebenzayo, ongasindisa izinkulungwane zezinkulungwane zezingane minyaka yonke. Ngokutshalwa kwezimali okuqhubekayo kanye nemizamo ekhuphukile yokufinyelela kulabo abasengozini enkulu, ukuqedwa kukamalaleveva emazweni amaningi kufinyeleleka. "Usuku Lomhlaba LweMalaleveva lwango-2023 luyagujwa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi "Isikhathi sokuletha umalaleveva ongekho: tshala, tsala izinto ezintsha, sebenzise". Ngaphakathi kwengqikithi, iWHO ikhuthaza ukuqaliswa okusebenzayo kwemithombo kanye namasu atholakalayo ukuze kuvinjelwe, kutholakale futhi kwelashwe umalaleveva, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasengcupheni. Ngokombiko wakamuva weWorld malaria, okhishwe ngoDisemba 2022, kwaba nezibalo ezintsha ezingaba yizigidi ezingama-247 zikamalaleveva ngo-2021. Isifunda Sase-Afrika seWHO siyaqhubeka nokubamba iqhaza eliyingozi kakhulu kwalesi sifo - okubalelwa kuilinganiselwa ku-95% wazo zonke izimo zikamalaleveva (izigidi ezingama-234) kanye no-96% wazo zonke ukufa (593 000) ngo-2021. Cishe u-80% wokufa umalaleveva esiFundeni sase-Afrika kwakungaphakathi kwezingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu. Amasu namathuluzi amasha Amazwe enze inqubekelaphambili ethile ekwandiseni ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zikamalaleveva kubantu abasengozini enkulu. Naphezu kwenqubekelaphambili ethile, abantu abaningi abasengozini enkulu yokungenwa umalaleveva basenokungafinyeleli ezinsizeni ezingavimbela, zitholele futhi zelaphe lesi sifo. Izinselele ekwandiseni ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zikamalaleveva ziye zaphinda zaphindeka, ikakhulukazi e-Afrika eseningizimu ye-Sahara, ngenxa yobhubhane lweCOVID-19, izinkinga ezihlangene zobuntu, ukuxhaswa ngezimali okulinganiselwe, izinhlelo zokuqapha ezibuthakathaka, kanye nokwehla kokusebenza kwethuluzi eliyinhloko lokulwa nomalaleveva. Ukubhekana nalezi zinsongo kanye nokweseka amazwe ekwakheni izinhlelo ezikwazi ukumelana nomalaleveva, iWHO isanda kushicilela amasu kanye nezinhlaka ezintsha, okuhlanganisa: isu elisha lokumelana nezidakamizwa zokulwa nomalaleveva e-Afrika; umkhankaso omusha wokumisa ukusabalala kwe-Anopheles stephensi ezindaweni zasemadolobheni; uhlaka olusha, olwenziwe ngokubambisana yiWHO kanye ne-UN-Habitat, oluqondisa abaholi bamadolobha ekulawuleni umalaleveva emadolobheni. ithuluzi elisha lokusiza amazwe ukuthi ahlole izinhlelo zawo zokuqapha umalaleveva futhi ahlole izindawo zokutshala imali IWHO iphinde yandisa ukubeka inqophamlando, ukuguquguquka kanye nokufinyelela ezihlongozweni zayo zikamalaleveva. IMIQONDISO yeWHO ehlanganisiwe yikamalaleveva manje isikhona ngezinkundla ezimbili zedijithali: i-MAGICapp kanye nohlelo lokusebenza lwe-“Malaria Toolkit”. IWHO ikhuthaza amazwe ukuthi avumelanise izincomo nezilungiselelo zezifo zendawo ukuze kube nomthelela omkhulu.

translations.source: Prospects for new interventions Continued investment in the development and deployment of new malaria vaccines and next-generation tools will be key to achieving the 2030 global malaria targets. A second malaria vaccine, the R21/Matrix-M (R21) vaccine, if approved, could help close the sizable gap between supply and demand and further reduce child illness and death from malaria. It is a priority for WHO to continue the thorough and efficient expert review of the R21 malaria vaccine once additional key safety and efficacy data from the ongoing R21 phase 3 trial are available and provided to WHO. Phased introductions of the RTS,S malaria vaccine in additional countries in Africa are expected to begin in early 2024. In the vector control space, there are 28 new products in the R&D pipeline. Tools under evaluation include, for example, new types of insecticide-treated nets, targeted baits that attract mosquitoes, spatial repellents, lethal house lures (eaves tubes) and genetic engineering of mosquitoes. Researchers are prioritizing the development of non-ACT treatments in the field of antimalarial medicines due to the emergence and spread of partial artemisinin resistance. The development of next-generation medicines, such as "triple ACTs," which use a combination of artemisinin and two partner drugs, is underway to reduce the risk of drug resistance. Notes to the editor:For more information on the WHO World Malaria Day campaign, visit: https://www.who.int/campaigns/world-malaria-day/2023
translations.reference: Izindlela zokungenelela okusha Ukuqhubeka kotshalomali ekuthuthukisweni nokubekwa kwemigomo emisha kamalaleveva namathuluzi esizukulwane esilandelayo kuzobalulekaukuthola okuqondwe ngomalaleveva emhlabeni 2030. Umgomo wesibili kamalaleveva, umgomo iR21/Matrix-M (R21), uma ugunyaziwe ungasiza ukuvala isikhala esikalekayo phakathi kwesaplayi mokufuneka nokuqhubeka ukwehlisa ukugula kwezingane nokufa okudalwa umalaleveva. Kuhamba phambili kuWHO ukuqhubeka ngokubheka kangoti kweR21 malaleveva ngesikhathi sekwengezwe okuphepha okubalulekile,nemininingo kusuka ekuqhubekeni kukaR21 isigaba 3 sesikhona nokinikezelwa kuWHO. Isigaba sokukhiqiza iRTS,S umgomo wamalaleveva emazweni engeziwe eAfrika kulindeleke ukuthi aqale ngokuqala kuka-2024. Endaweni yokulawula ivekitha,kukhona imikhiqizoemisha engu-28 kokuzayo kweR&D. Amathuluzi asabhekisiswa afka, isibonelo, izinhlobo ezintsha zamanethi okulapha izinambuzane, izicuphomziqonde ukudonsa omiyane, isipeshali ripheleli, okwasendlini, (i-eaves tubes) nobunjiniyela bofuzo lwemiyane. Abacwaningi bahambisa phambili ukuthuthuka kokulashwa okungeyona i-ACTS emikhakheni wemithi omele umalaleveva ngenxa yokuphuthuma nokusabalala kokungavuminokuncane kwe-artemisinin. Ukdevelophwa kwemithi yesizukulwane esilandelayo, njenge ACTS, okusebenzisa ukuhlanganiswa kwe-artemisinin nezidakamizwa zimbili, kusendleleni kuzokwehlisa ingcuphe yokungavumi kwesidakamizwa. Amanothi aya kumhleli: ngolwazi olwengeziwe ekukhankaseni ngoSuku lukamalaleveva eMhlabeni lweWHO, vakashela u-http://www.who.int/campains/world-malaria-day/2023
translations.hypothesis: Amathuba okungenelela okusha Ukutshalwa kwezimali okuqhubekayo ekuthuthukisweni nasekuthuthukisweni kwemithi yokugomela umalaleveva emuva kokuhlaselwa kanye namathuluzi esizukulwane esilandelayo kuzobaluleka ekufinyeleleni imigomo yomhlaba wonke ngokuphathelene nomalaleveva ka-2030. Umuthi wokugomela umalaleveva wesibili, iR21/Matrix-M (R21), uma ivunyelwe, ingasiza ukuvala igebe elikhulu phakathi kokuhlinzekwayo nokufunwayo futhi yehlise ukuphuthuma kwezingane nokufa kwabantu ngenxa yomalaleveva. Kuwukubaluleka kakhulu kuWHO ukuthi iqhubekele phambili ekubuyekezweni okugxilile nokusebenzayo kongaqwasizinda umuthi wokugomela umalaleveva iR21 uma isitholakala futhi sinikezwe kuWHO idatha eyengeziwe yezokuphepha nokusebenza ngendlela efanele esivivinyweni siqhubekayo seR21 sezigaba ezi-3. Ukwethulwa ngamaqhekezi komuthi wokugomela umalaleveva iRTS,S emazweni engeziwe ase-Afrika kulindeleke ukuthi kuqale ngasekuqaleni kuka-2024. Endaweni yokulawula ama-vector, kukhona imikhiqizo emisha engama-28 ku-R&D pipeline. Amathuluzi angaphansi kokuhlolwa, ngokwesibonelo, izinhlobo ezintsha zamasheya elaliswe izibulali-zinambuzane, izibambiso eziqondiswe ezihlukunyezwa omiyane, izinto ezikhipha izilokazane, izinto ezibulala ezindlini (amapayipi ezindlini) kanye nokwenziwa kwezakhi zokuzala ngokuphathelene omiyane. Abacwaningi babeka eqhulwini ukuthuthukiswa kokwelashwa okungekona i-ACT emkhakheni wezokwelapha umalaleveva ngenxa yokuvela nokusabalala kokumelana ne-artemisinin ngokwengxenye. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemithi yesizukulwane esilandelayo, njenge-"triple ACTs," esebenzisa inhlanganisela ye-artemisinin kanye nezidakamizwa ezimbili zabangane, kuyaqhubeka ukuze kuncishiswe ingozi yokumelana nezidakamizwa. Amanothi kumhleli: Ukuze uthole ulwazi olwengeziwe ngomkhankaso weWHO World Malaria Day, vakashela: https://www.who.int/campaigns/world-malaria-day/2023

translations.source: mRNA Technology Transfer Programme moves to the next phase of its development Inauguration of the mRNA technology Hub facility at Afrigen, South Africa. Partners gather in Cape Town to discuss the next phase of the mRNA vaccine development and knowledge sharing. Over 200 international participants working with the mRNA Technology Transfer Programme met in Cape Town this week for their first face-to-face meeting. Joined by World Health Organization (WHO) Director General, Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Dr. Joe Phaahla, Minister of Health and Minister of Trade and Industry, Mr. Ebrahim Patel of South Africa together with high-level officials from funding countries, this unique meeting reviewed the progress since WHO and Medicines Patent Pool (MPP) launched it in June 2021. “I am delighted to be here in Cape Town with our partners to support a sustainable model for mRNA technology transfer to give low- and middle-income countries equitable access to vaccines and other lifesaving health products,” said WHO Director-General Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. “I am immensely proud of the achievement of all those involved in this project; in less than two years we have shown that when we work collaboratively, we succeed collectively.” The meeting participants include biomanufacturing partners from 15 countries in the Programme, leading experts, industry, civil society representatives, and funders. During the five-day meeting, participants will share progress and discuss critical enablers for the sustainability of the Programme such as intellectual property issues and regulatory aspects, as well as the science of mRNA technologies and key applications relevant to LMICs in other disease areas such as HIV and tuberculosis. The COVID-19 pandemic has underscored that gross inequity exists in access to health products, especially vaccines. As of March 2023, more than three years after WHO declared COVID-19 a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), 69.7% of the global population had received at least one dose of a COVID-19 vaccine. Notably, this proportion still remains below 30% in low-income countries (LICs) . This Programme aims to contribute to equitable access to mRNA vaccines by increasing the distribution of sustainable manufacturing capacity across LMICs, enhancing regional and inter-regional collaborations, and developing and empowering a local workforce through tailored and inclusive training and expert support. What is unique in the mRNA Technology Transfer model is the multilateral process that allows sharing of technologies to multiple recipients so that through local and regional production those in need can be reached rapidly. Dr Phaahla, Minister of Health South Africa, said: “What we see here today, is a moment in history, a Programme that is aimed at empowering LMICs through a global collaborative network. I am thrilled to see the progress made in such a relatively short time and welcome the support from so many different countries - countries like South Africa that have a strong vibrant biomanufacturing capacity and that are willing to work together, learn from and share with each other.” Minister Blade Nzimande of Higher Education and Science, said: “Ours is the vision of the mRNA Technology Transfer Hub beyond just COVID-19. The capabilities we are building are looking to empower us to deal with other future pandemics whose vaccines could use the same mRNA technology platform. It is a vision that has set its eyes on diseases that are prevalent in our environments such as Malaria, Tuberculosis and HIV and AIDS.” This occasion also marks an important milestone for the Programme with the inauguration of the mRNA technology Hub facility at Afrigen in Cape Town in the presence of Dr. Tedros and Dr. Matshidiso Moeti WHO Regional Director for Africa, Charles Gore Executive Director of MPP and the Honorable Ministers who took part in a ribbon cutting ceremony at Afrigen. Professor Petro Terblanche, Executive Director of Afrigen said: “The entire Afrigen team are thrilled to reach this important milestone with the completion of the mRNA technology platform. This platform is housed within the end-to-end mRNA vaccine development and production facility where the mRNA Hub Covid 19 vaccine candidate AfriVac 2121 is currently in scale-up phase. Over the last 18 months, Afrigen has undergone an incredible transformation with the support of a network of partners and mentors enabled by this Programme. We have grown our capability and capacity to meet the highest quality standards of mRNA vaccine development, serving the objective to build sustainable capacity in LMICs to produce mRNA vaccines”. Afrigen has successfully established a COVID-19 vaccine manufacturing process at a laboratory scale and is currently scaling up that process to a level suitable for manufacturing vaccine batches to be used in Phase I/ II clinical trials to GMP standards.
translations.reference: Uhlelo loKudlulisela ezobuchwepheshe i-mRNA iya esigabeni esilandelayo ekuthuthukeni kwayo Ukwethulwa kwehabhu yezobuchwepheshe imRNA indawo e-Afrigen, eNingizimu Afrika. Ababambisani bahlangane eKapa ukuxoxa ngesigaba esilandelayo semRNA umgomo ngokuthuthukisa nokwabelana ngolwazi. Ngaphezu kwababambiqhaza abangu-200 bamazwe angaphandle abasebenza ngoHlelo loKudlulisela lezoBuchwepheshe beMRNA abahlangane eKapa kulelisonto ukuze bahlangane bebonana. Ukujoyinwa iNhlangano yeZempilo eMhlabeni (WHO) uMqondisi Jikelele uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noDkt Joe Phaahla uNgqongqoshe weZempilo noNgqongqoshe Wezimboni nokuhweba uMnumzane Ebrahim waseNingizimu Afrika ndawonye nezikhulu ezisezingeni eliphezulu eziphuma emazweni axhasile, lomhlangano owehlukile ubheke ukuqhubeka kusukela ukwethula kweWHO neMedicines Patent Pool (MPP) ngoNhlangulana 2021. "Ngiyajabula ukuba lapha eKapa kanye nababambisani bethu ukuzokweseka imodeli egcinekayo yokudluliselwa kobuchwepheshe mRNA ukunikeza amazwe anemali engenayo encane kuya kwephakathi nendawo ukuthola ngokulingana umgomo kanye neminye imikhiqizo yezempilo esindisa izimpilo zabantu," kusho uMqondisi Jikelele weWHO, uDkt Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. "Ngijabule kakhulu ngokuzuziwe kubona bonke ababambe iqhaza kulephrojekthi,ngaphansi kweminyaka emibili sesikhombisile ukuthi uma sisebenza ngokubambisana, siphumelela sonke."
